                            fontSize="13px"
                            fontWeight="900"
                            textAnchor="middle"
                            className="font-sans"
                            style={{
                              textShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.9)',
                            }}
                          >
                            تمام این دایلاینها باید در این منطقه باشد و بیرون از این منطقه
                          </text>
                          
                          {/* Left-align / Right-align auxiliary indicators for sheet corners */}
                          <circle cx={((dieline.xMin + dieline.xMax) / 2) - sheetSize.width / 2} cy={((dieline.yMin + dieline.yMax) / 2) - sheetSize.height / 2} r="4" fill="#38bdf8" />
                          <circle cx={((dieline.xMin + dieline.xMax) / 2) + sheetSize.width / 2} cy={((dieline.yMin + dieline.yMax) / 2) - sheetSize.height / 2} r="4" fill="#38bdf8" />
                          <circle cx={((dieline.xMin + dieline.xMax) / 2) - sheetSize.width / 2} cy={((dieline.yMin + dieline.yMax) / 2) + sheetSize.height / 2} r="4" fill="#38bdf8" />
                          <circle cx={((dieline.xMin + dieline.xMax) / 2) + sheetSize.width / 2} cy={((dieline.yMin + dieline.yMax) / 2) + sheetSize.height / 2} r="4" fill="#38bdf8" />
                        </g>

                        {/* 3cm (30mm) Offset Margin Box around the dieline */}
                        {isBleedVisible && (
                          <g id="cad-offset-margin-group">
                            <rect
                              id="cad-offset-margin-box"
                              x={dieline.xMin - bleedOffset}
                              y={dieline.yMin - bleedOffset}
                              width={dieline.totalW + (bleedOffset * 2)}
                              height={dieline.totalH + (bleedOffset * 2)}
                              fill="none"
                              stroke={layers.find(l => l.id === 'bleed')?.color || themeStyle.offsetColor}
                              strokeWidth="0.85"
                              strokeDasharray="4,3"
                              opacity="0.85"
                            />
                            <text
                              id="cad-offset-text-label"
                              x={dieline.xMin - bleedOffset + 5}
                              y={dieline.yMin - bleedOffset - 6}
                              fontSize="7.5"
                              fill={layers.find(l => l.id === 'bleed')?.color || themeStyle.offsetColor}
                              fontWeight="bold"
                              className="font-sans opacity-95"
                            >
                              محدوده آفست {bleedOffset} میلی‌متر ({bleedOffset}mm Bleed Offset)
                            </text>
                          </g>
                        )}

                        <g className="die-cut-layer">
                          {/* Render Creases based on the theme style with fine stroke-widths */}
                          {isCreasesVisible && dieline.creases.map((pathStr, index) => (
                            <path 
                              id={`cad-crease-line-${index}`}
                              key={`cr-${index}`} 
                              d={pathStr} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.creaseColor} 
                              strokeWidth="0.32" 
                              strokeDasharray="4,2.5" 
                              fill="none" 
                              opacity="0.9" 
                            />
                          ))}
                          {/* Render Cuts based on the theme style with fine stroke-widths */}
                          {isCutsVisible && dieline.cuts.map((pathStr, index) => (
                            <path 
                              id={`cad-cut-line-${index}`}
                              key={`ct-${index}`} 
                              d={pathStr} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.cutColor} 
                              strokeWidth="0.48" 
                              fill="none" 
                              strokeLinecap="round" 
                              strokeLinejoin="round" 
                              opacity="0.95"
                            />
                          ))}
                        </g>
 
                        {/* Dimension markers on SVG layout */}
                        {showDimensions && isDimensionsVisible && dieline.labels.map((l, index) => (
                          <g id={`cad-dim-badge-group-${index}`} key={`lb-${index}`}>
                            <rect 
                              id={`cad-dim-badge-bg-${index}`}
                              x={l.x - 11} 
                              y={l.y - 5.5} 
                              width="22" 
                              height="11" 
                              fill={themeStyle.labelBg} 
                              rx="2.5" 
                              stroke={themeStyle.labelBorder} 
                              strokeWidth="0.6" 
                            />
                            <text 
                              id={`cad-dim-badge-text-${index}`}
                              x={l.x} 
                              y={l.y + 2.5} 
                              fontSize="6.5" 
                              fontWeight="bold" 
                              fill={themeStyle.labelText} 
                              textAnchor="middle" 
                              className="select-none font-mono"
                            >
                              {l.text}
                            </text>
                          </g>
                        ))}

                         {/* Native CAD Arrow Dimensions Group */}
                        {showDimensions && (
                          <g id="cad-svg-arrow-dimensions-layer" opacity="0.95">
                            {/* Horizontal Top Width dimension arrow line */}
                            <line 
                              x1={dieline.xMin} 
                              y1={dieline.yMin - 48} 
                              x2={dieline.xMax} 
                              y2={dieline.yMin - 48} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.textColor} 
                              strokeWidth="1.2" 
                            />
                            {/* Tick marks or left/right arrow heads */}
                            <path d={`M ${dieline.xMin} ${dieline.yMin - 53} L ${dieline.xMin} ${dieline.yMin - 43}`} stroke={themeStyle.textColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
                            <path d={`M ${dieline.xMax} ${dieline.yMin - 53} L ${dieline.xMax} ${dieline.yMin - 43}`} stroke={themeStyle.textColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
                            {/* Width Label box and text */}
                            <rect 
                              x={(dieline.xMin + dieline.xMax) / 2 - 68} 
                              y={dieline.yMin - 56} 
                              width="136" 
                              height="16" 
                              fill={themeStyle.labelBg} 
                              rx="3" 
                              stroke={themeStyle.labelBorder} 
                              strokeWidth="0.8" 
                            />
                            <text 
                              x={(dieline.xMin + dieline.xMax) / 2} 
                              y={dieline.yMin - 45} 
                              fontSize="8" 
                              fontWeight="bold" 
                              fill={themeStyle.labelText} 
                              textAnchor="middle"
                              className="font-mono text-[8px]"
                            >
                              عرض کل (W): {Math.round(dieline.totalW)} mm
                            </text>

                            {/* Vertical Left Height dimension arrow line */}
                            <line 
                              x1={dieline.xMin - 48} 
                              y1={dieline.yMin} 
                              x2={dieline.xMin - 48} 
                              y2={dieline.yMax} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.textColor} 
                              strokeWidth="1.2" 
                            />
                            {/* Tick marks */}
                            <path d={`M ${dieline.xMin - 53} ${dieline.yMin} L ${dieline.xMin - 43} ${dieline.yMin}`} stroke={themeStyle.textColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
                            <path d={`M ${dieline.xMin - 53} ${dieline.yMax} L ${dieline.xMin - 43} ${dieline.yMax}`} stroke={themeStyle.textColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
                            {/* Height Label box and text */}
                            <g transform={`translate(${dieline.xMin - 48}, ${(dieline.yMin + dieline.yMax) / 2})`}>
                              <rect 
                                x="-8" 
                                y="-68" 
                                width="16" 
                                height="136" 
                                fill={themeStyle.labelBg} 
                                rx="3" 
                                stroke={themeStyle.labelBorder} 
                                strokeWidth="0.8" 
                              />
                              <text 
                                x="0" 
                                y="0" 
                                transform="rotate(-90)" 
                                fontSize="8" 
                                fontWeight="bold" 
                                fill={themeStyle.labelText} 
                                textAnchor="middle"
                                dy="3.5"
                                className="font-mono text-[8px]"
                              >
                                ارتفاع کل (H): {Math.round(dieline.totalH)} mm
                              </text>
                            </g>
                          </g>
                        )}

                        {/* 3cm (30mm) Offset Margin Box around the dieline */}
                        <rect
                          id="cad-offset-margin-box"
                          x={dieline.xMin - 30}
                          y={dieline.yMin - 30}
                          width={dieline.totalW + 60}
                          height={dieline.totalH + 60}
                          fill="none"
                          stroke={themeStyle.offsetColor}
                          strokeWidth="1.2"
                          strokeDasharray="4,4"
                          opacity="0.85"
                        />
                        <text
                          id="cad-offset-text-label"
                          x={dieline.xMin - 25}
                          y={dieline.yMin - 36}
                          fontSize="9"
                          fill={themeStyle.offsetColor}
                          fontWeight="bold"
                          className="font-sans font-black opacity-80"
                        >
                          محدوده آفست ۳ سانتی‌متر (30mm Bleed Offset)
                        </text>

                        <g className="die-cut-layer">
                          {/* Render Creases based on the theme style with organic variable stroke-widths */}
                          {dieline.creases.map((pathStr, index) => (
                            <path 
                              id={`cad-crease-line-${index}`}
                              key={`cr-${index}`} 
                              d={pathStr} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.creaseColor} 
                              strokeWidth={index % 2 === 0 ? "0.65" : "0.85"} 
                              strokeDasharray="3,1.5" 
                              fill="none" 
                              opacity="0.85" 
                            />
                          ))}
                          {/* Render Cuts based on the theme style with organic variable stroke-widths */}
                          {dieline.cuts.map((pathStr, index) => (
                            <path 
                              id={`cad-cut-line-${index}`}
                              key={`ct-${index}`} 
                              d={pathStr} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.cutColor} 
                              strokeWidth={index % 3 === 0 ? "0.95" : index % 3 === 1 ? "1.2" : "0.9"} 
                              fill="none" 
                              strokeLinecap="round" 
                              strokeLinejoin="round" 
                              opacity="0.9"
                            />
                          ))}
                        </g>

                        {/* Dimension markers on SVG layout */}
                        {showDimensions && dieline.labels.map((l, index) => (
                          <g id={`cad-dim-badge-group-${index}`} key={`lb-${index}`}>
                            <rect 
                              id={`cad-dim-badge-bg-${index}`}
                              x={l.x - 14} 
                              y={l.y - 7} 
                              width="28" 
                              height="14" 
                              fill={themeStyle.labelBg} 
                              rx="3" 
                              stroke={themeStyle.labelBorder} 
                              strokeWidth="0.8" 
                            />
                            <text 
                              id={`cad-dim-badge-text-${index}`}
                              x={l.x} 
                              y={l.y + 3.5} 
                              fontSize="8" 
                              fontWeight="900" 
                              fill={themeStyle.labelText} 
                              textAnchor="middle" 
                              className="select-none font-mono"
                            >
                              {l.text}
                            </text>
                          </g>
                        ))}

                        {/* CAD Legend Box */}
                        <g id="cad-legend-box-group" transform={`translate(${dieline.xMax - 95}, ${dieline.yMin - 40})`} className="opacity-95">
                          <rect 
                            id="cad-legend-box"
                            width="105" 
                            height="42" 
                            fill={themeStyle.legendBg} 
                            stroke={themeStyle.legendBorder} 
                            strokeWidth="1"
                            rx="4" 
                          />
                          <line x1="10" y1="14" x2="30" y2="14" stroke={themeStyle.cutColor} strokeWidth="1.05" />
                          <text x="35" y="17" fontSize="8" fill={themeStyle.legendText} fontWeight="900">CUT (تیغ)</text>
                          <line x1="10" y1="28" x2="30" y2="28" stroke={themeStyle.creaseColor} strokeWidth="0.85" strokeDasharray="3,1.5" />
                          <text x="35" y="31" fontSize="8" fill={themeStyle.legendText} fontWeight="900">CREASE (خط تا)</text>
                        </g>

                        {/* Live Coordinate Snapping Crosshair Overlay (snapped to 0.01mm) */}
                        {svgCursor && (
                          <g id="cad-coordinate-crosshair-group" className="pointer-events-none">
                            {/* Horizontal tracking line */}
                            <line 
                              x1={dieline.xMin - 1600} 
                              y1={svgCursor.y} 
                              x2={dieline.xMax + 1600} 
                              y2={svgCursor.y} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.textColor} 
                              strokeWidth="0.4"
                              strokeDasharray="3,3"
                              opacity="0.4"
                            />
                            {/* Vertical tracking line */}
                            <line 
                              x1={svgCursor.x} 
                              y1={dieline.yMin - 1600} 
                              x2={svgCursor.x} 
                              y2={dieline.yMax + 1600} 
                              stroke={themeStyle.textColor} 
                              strokeWidth="0.4"
                              strokeDasharray="3,3"
                              opacity="0.4"
                            />
                            {/* Intersection blinking target cursor */}
                            <circle 
                              cx={svgCursor.x} 
                              cy={svgCursor.y} 
                              r="3.5" 
                              fill="none" 
                              stroke={themeStyle.cutColor} 
                              strokeWidth="1.2"
                              className="animate-pulse"
                            />
                            {/* Snapped numeric display HUD block inside SVG */}
                            <g transform={`translate(${svgCursor.x + 8}, ${svgCursor.y - 8})`}>
                              <rect 
                                width="74" 
                                height="22" 
                                fill={themeStyle.labelBg} 
                                stroke={themeStyle.labelBorder} 
                                strokeWidth="0.8" 
                                rx="3"
                                opacity="0.9"
                              />
                              <text 
                                x="37" 
                                y="13" 
                                textAnchor="middle" 
                                fill={themeStyle.labelText} 
                                fontSize="7" 
                                fontWeight="bold" 
                                className="font-mono"
                              >
                                {svgCursor.x.toFixed(2)}, {svgCursor.y.toFixed(2)}
                              </text>
                            </g>
                          </g>
                        )}

                        {/* Interactive smaller 3D button docked nicely inside the corner of the dieline bounding rect */}
                        <foreignObject
                          x={dieline.xMin + 12}
                          y={dieline.yMax - 54}
                          width="58"
                          height="52"
                          className="overflow-visible"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setViewMode('3d')}
                              className="group relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-[#080c14]/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/60 hover:border-indigo-500 shadow-md hover:shadow-indigo-500/15 shadow-black/50 transition-all cursor-pointer select-none w-11 h-12 overflow-hidden"
                              title="ورود به فضای سه‌بعدی جعبه"
                              style={{ fontStyle: 'normal' }}
                              type="button"
                            >
                              {/* Glowing backdrop aura */}
                              <span className="absolute -inset-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500/10 to-cyan-500/10 blur-sm opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300"></span>
                              
                              {/* Custom isometric 3D wireframe cube */}
                              <div className="w-[18px] h-[18px] relative flex items-center justify-center">
                                <svg 
                                  viewBox="0 0 100 115"
                                  className="w-full h-full drop-shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)] transition-transform duration-350 group-hover:rotate-[3deg]"
                                >
                                  <defs>
                                    <linearGradient id="miniCubeGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                                      <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#22d3ee" />
                                      <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#6366f1" />
                                    </linearGradient>
                                  </defs>
                                  
                                  {/* Cube Wireframe */}
                                  <polygon 
                                    points="50,21 20,38 20,68 50,85 80,68 80,38" 
                                    stroke="url(#miniCubeGrad)" 
                                    strokeWidth="4" 
                                    strokeLinecap="round" 
                                    strokeLinejoin="round" 
                                    fill="rgba(9,13,22,0.6)" 
                                  />
                                  <line x1="50" y1="52" x2="50" y2="85" stroke="url(#miniCubeGrad)" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
                                  <line x1="50" y1="52" x2="20" y2="38" stroke="url(#miniCubeGrad)" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
                                  <line x1="50" y1="52" x2="80" y2="38" stroke="url(#miniCubeGrad)" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
                                </svg>
                              </div>

                              {/* Mini label with status light */}
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 justify-center mt-0.5 z-10">
                                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                                <span className="text-[7.5px] font-black text-white font-sans group-hover:text-cyan-300 transition-colors uppercase">
                                  3D
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </foreignObject>
                      </svg>
                    );
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

                  {/* Specs validation banner overlays inside viewport */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Badge color="green" className="font-mono text-[8px] font-black uppercase">METRIC STANDARDS ACCURATE</Badge>
                    <Badge color="blue" className="font-mono text-[8px] font-black uppercase">100% CAD COMPRESSED</Badge>
                  </div>

                  {/* Production-grade 'Engineering Status' overlay (remains visible floating over the dieline canvas) */}
                  {showTelemetry && !isMobile && (
                    <motion.div 
                      drag
                      dragMomentum={false}
                      className="absolute top-20 left-6 z-30 w-72 bg-[#0c121d]/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800/80 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-xl shadow-black/80 select-none cursor-move animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200"
                      dir="rtl"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800/70 pb-2 mb-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-400 animate-pulse"></div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-sky-400 font-sans tracking-wide">وضعیت مهندسی نقشه (CAD)</span>
                        </div>
                        <button 
                          onClick={() => setShowTelemetry(false)}
                          className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200 bg-slate-950/50 hover:bg-slate-900/70 p-1 rounded-lg border-none cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="پنهان کردن پانل"
                        >
                          <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-3">
                        {/* Geometric score */}
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                            <span className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 font-bold">امتیاز صحت ابعادی و هندسه:</span>
                            <span className={`text-[10px] font-black font-mono ${geometryReport.score >= 95 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                              {geometryReport.score}٪
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="w-full bg-slate-900/90 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden border border-slate-800/60">
                            <div 
                              className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-350 ${geometryReport.score >= 95 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-rose-500'}`}
                              style={{ width: `${geometryReport.score}%` }}
                            ></div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Material usage details */}
                        <div className="bg-[#070a0e]/60 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/40 text-[9px] space-y-1.5">
                          <div className="flex justify-between">
                            <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans">شاسی متریال جاری:</span>
                            <strong className="text-slate-200 truncate max-w-[140px] text-left">{material.name}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between">
                            <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans">مساحت باز شده قالب:</span>
                            <strong className="text-sky-450 font-mono">{((dieline.totalW * dieline.totalH) / 10000).toFixed(1)} cm²</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between">
                            <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans">مقاومت بدنه کرش کاغذی (BCT):</span>
                            <strong className="text-amber-400 font-mono">{physicsReport ? `${physicsReport.strengthBCT} kgf` : 'نامشخص'}</strong>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* FEFCO/ECMA compliance status */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900/50 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/40">
                          <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-450/90 shrink-0" />
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <span className="text-[8px] text-slate-500 block">استاندارد لیتوگرافی ملیت:</span>
                            <strong className="text-[10px] text-sky-300 font-bold block truncate">
                              {selectedModel.id.startsWith('fefco') ? 'FEFCO 0200 / استاندارد ففکو کارتن' : 'ECMA C31 / استاندارد جعبه آرایی پپلو'}
                            </strong>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Quality and compliance checks */}
                        <div className="text-[9px] flex flex-col gap-1 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-0.5" dir="rtl">
                          {validatorIssues.slice(0, 2).map((issue, idx) => (
                            <div 
                              key={idx} 
                              className={`px-1.5 py-1 rounded border ${
                                issue.type === 'error' ? 'bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-900/30 text-rose-300' :
                                issue.type === 'warning' ? 'bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-900/30 text-amber-300' :
                                'bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-800 text-slate-300'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {issue.msg}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  )}

                </div>
              ) : (
                /* --- DISPLAY 3D PREVIEW MODE --- */
                <div className="flex-1 w-full relative flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden">
                  
                  {/* ThreeDPreview component mounting container */}
                  <div className="flex-1 w-full bg-[#050608] flex items-center justify-center relative min-h-[300px] lg:min-h-[500px]">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10">
                      <ThreeDPreview 
                        width={dims.L}
                        height={dims.W}
                        depth={dims.H}
                        color={material.color || '#e2cfb6'}
                        paperType={material.id.includes('corrugated') ? 'corrugated' : material.id.includes('kraft') ? 'kraft' : 'coated'}
                        isOpenRatio={foldRatio}
                        textureUrl={textureUrl}
                        specialEffect={specialEffect}
                        autoRotate={autoRotate}
                        cameraOrbit={cameraOrbit}
                        resetTrigger={resetTrigger}
                        viewAngle={viewAngle}
                        isExploded={isExploded}
                        flapDirections={flapDirections}
                        hasDieCut={false}
                        selectedModelId={selectedModel.id}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Floating CAD Camera Presets Selector */}
                    <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 z-20 flex flex-col gap-1.5 bg-[#0a0f1d]/90 backdrop-blur-md p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 shadow-xl" dir="rtl">
                      <span className="text-[8.5px] font-black text-slate-400 pr-1 select-none tracking-wider font-sans uppercase">زاویه دوربین (CAD Camera Angle)</span>
                      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setViewAngle('perspective')}
                          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-black font-sans flex items-center gap-1 transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                            viewAngle === 'perspective' ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-400 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30' : 'bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Rotate3d className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-300" />
                          <span>پرسپکتیو</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setViewAngle('front')}
                          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-black font-sans transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                            viewAngle === 'front' ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-400 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30' : 'bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span>روبرو</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setViewAngle('top')}
                          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-black font-sans transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                            viewAngle === 'top' ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-400 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30' : 'bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span>بالا</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setViewAngle('side')}
                          className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-black font-sans transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                            viewAngle === 'side' ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-400 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30' : 'bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span>بغل</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Floating Secondary Structure Parameters in 3D Mode */}
                    <div className="absolute top-26 left-4 z-20 w-64 md:w-72 bg-[#0c1015]/93 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-black/60 p-4 font-sans custom-scrollbar" dir="rtl">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 border-b border-slate-700/50 pb-2">
                         <Settings className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                         <span className="text-white text-[11px] font-bold font-sans">پارامترهای ثانویه استراکچر</span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Special printed finishes */}
                      <div className="mt-4">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-white block mb-2 font-sans">نوع فرآیند خدمات پس از چاپ</span>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                          {[
                            { id: 'none', label: 'خام بدون افکت' },
                            { id: 'gold_foil', label: 'طلاکوب متالایز' },
                            { id: 'uv_spot', label: 'UV موضعی' },
                            { id: 'both', label: 'طلاکوب + UV دوبل' }
                          ].map(eff => (
                            <button
                              key={eff.id}
                              onClick={() => setSpecialEffect(eff.id as any)}
                              className={`py-2 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer ${specialEffect === eff.id ? 'bg-amber-600 border-amber-400 text-white shadow-md' : 'bg-[#070a0e]/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:bg-[#070a0e]/90 hover:text-slate-350'}`}
                              type="button"
                            >
                              {eff.label}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* PBR Texture Custom Upload Section */}
                      <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-705/50">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-white block mb-2 font-sans flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                          <span>طرح یا بافت چاپی دلخواه (PBR Canvas)</span>
                        </span>
                        
                        <input 
                          type="file" 
                          ref={fileInputRef} 
                          onChange={handleTextureUpload} 
                          accept="image/*" 
                          className="hidden" 
                        />

                        {textureUrl ? (
                          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/60 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <img 
                                src={textureUrl} 
                                alt="Custom skin texture" 
                                className="w-8 h-8 rounded border border-slate-700 object-cover" 
                                referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                              />
                              <div>
                                <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-rose-400 block font-sans">بافت اختصاصی فعال</span>
                                <span className="text-[8px] text-slate-400 block font-sans">نمایش روی بدنه ۳بعدی</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setTextureUrl(null)}
                              className="p-1.5 bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 border border-rose-900/50 hover:bg-rose-950/80 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                              title="حذف روپوش متریال"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                            className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-500 bg-[#070a0e]/40 hover:bg-indigo-950/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-400 text-[10px] font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                            <span>بارگذاری فایل تصویر (طرح چاپی جعبه)</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-400 mt-1.5 block leading-relaxed" dir="rtl">
                          💡 با بارگذاری تصویر چاپی جعبه، طرح مستقیماً بر روی سطوح سه‌بعدی قالب به صورت دقیق (PBR Wrapper) پوشانده می‌شود.
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* PDF output settings and line thickness */}
                      <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-700/50 space-y-4">
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1.5 flex justify-between items-center font-sans">
                            <span>کیفیت خروجی نقشه</span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-emerald-400">{pdfQuality === 'high' ? 'عالی' : 'استاندارد'}</span>
                          </label>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setPdfQuality('standard')}
                              className={`py-1 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${pdfQuality === 'standard' ? 'bg-[#1f2d42] text-white font-black' : 'text-slate-550 hover:bg-[#1f2d42]/30'}`}
                              type="button"
                            >
                              150 DPI
                            </button>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setPdfQuality('high')}
                              className={`py-1 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${pdfQuality === 'high' ? 'bg-[#1f2d42] text-white font-black' : 'text-slate-550 hover:bg-[#1f2d42]/30'}`}
                              type="button"
                            >
                              300 DPI
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1.5 flex justify-between items-center font-sans">
                            <span>ضخامت خطوط</span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-sky-405">{lineWidthStyle === 'bold' ? 'ضخیم' : 'ظریف'}</span>
                          </label>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setLineWidthStyle('standard')}
                              className={`py-1 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${lineWidthStyle === 'standard' ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-900'}`}
                              type="button"
                            >
                              معمولی
                            </button>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setLineWidthStyle('bold')}
                              className={`py-1 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${lineWidthStyle === 'bold' ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-900'}`}
                              type="button"
                            >
                              ضخیم
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Folding simulation controls */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-x-4 bottom-22 lg:bottom-12 flex justify-center z-20 transition-all duration-300">
                    {is3DControlsCollapsed ? (
                      <motion.button
                        layoutId="folding-controls-panel"
                        onClick={() => setIs3DControlsCollapsed(false)}
                        className="bg-[#111622]/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-indigo-500/30 hover:border-indigo-400/60 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-all text-xs font-bold font-sans"
                        dir="rtl"
                      >
                        <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-455 animate-pulse" />
                        <span>تنظیمات تا کردن و شبیه‌ساز سه بعدی (۳D)</span>
                        <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 rotate-180 transition-transform" />
                      </motion.button>
                    ) : (
                      <motion.div 
                        layoutId="folding-controls-panel"
                        className="bg-[#111622]/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800/80 p-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4 items-center justify-between w-full max-w-5xl relative animate-fade-in"
                        dir="rtl"
                      >
                        {/* Section 1: Slider, Player, and Quick presets */}
                        <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-center gap-3 w-full lg:w-auto flex-1">
                          
                          {/* Play/Pause simulation triggers */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-850/70 p-1.5 rounded-xl shrink-0">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setIsFoldingAnimPlaying(!isFoldingAnimPlaying);
                                if (!isFoldingAnimPlaying && foldRatio >= 1.0) {
                                  // restart from flat
                                  setFoldRatio(0.0);
                                  animDirectionRef.current = 'forward';
                                }
                              }}
                              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer text-[10px] ${
                                isFoldingAnimPlaying 
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/30' 
                                  : 'bg-[#121c2c] hover:bg-slate-800 text-sky-450 border border-sky-950'
                              }`}
                              title={isFoldingAnimPlaying ? "توقف بازیابی خودکار تا کردن" : "شبیه‌سازی خودکار تا زدن جعبه در ۳D"}
                            >
                              {isFoldingAnimPlaying ? (
                                <>
                                  <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white shrink-0 animate-pulse" />
                                  <span>توقف فرآیند</span>
                                </>
                              ) : (
                                <>
                                  <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-300 shrink-0" />
                                  <span className="font-sans font-black text-sky-200">شبیه‌سازی فرآیند تا</span>
                                </>
                              )}
                            </button>

                            {/* Speed selector */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 border-r border-slate-800 pr-1.5 mr-1 bg-slate-950 px-1 rounded-md">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setFoldingSpeed(0.003)}
                                className={`px-2 py-1 text-[8.5px] rounded font-mono font-bold transition-all ${
                                  foldingSpeed === 0.003 ? 'bg-indigo-650 text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200'
                                }`}
                                title="سرعت آهسته (0.5x) برای بررسی و آنالیز دقیق‌تر تقاطع گوشه‌ها"
                              >
                                0.5x
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setFoldingSpeed(0.008)}
                                className={`px-2 py-1 text-[8.5px] rounded font-mono font-bold transition-all ${
                                  foldingSpeed === 0.008 ? 'bg-indigo-655 text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200'
                                }`}
                                title="سرعت متوسط (1x)"
                              >
                                1x
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setFoldingSpeed(0.016)}
                                className={`px-2 py-1 text-[8.5px] rounded font-mono font-bold transition-all ${
                                  foldingSpeed === 0.016 ? 'bg-indigo-650 text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200'
                                }`}
                                title="سرعت بالا (2x)"
                              >
                                2x
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* Center Indicator & Slider */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5 flex-1 w-full xl:w-auto">
                            <div className="flex flex-col items-start shrink-0">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-350 font-sans whitespace-nowrap">وضعیت تاخوردگی:</span>
                                <span className="font-mono bg-slate-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-sky-400 text-[10.5px] font-black shadow-inner">{Math.round(foldRatio * 100)}%</span>
                              </div>
                              <span className="text-[7.5px] text-emerald-450/90 font-bold block leading-none mt-1 animate-pulse" dir="rtl">💡 پایش برخورد و تداخل زواایای لبه‌ها</span>
                            </div>

                            <input 
                              type="range" 
                              min="-1" 
                              max="1" 
                              step="0.01" 
                              value={foldRatio} 
                              onChange={e => {
                                setFoldRatio(parseFloat(e.target.value));
                                setIsFoldingAnimPlaying(false); // pause play when dragging slider manually
                              }} 
                              className="flex-1 min-w-[140px] h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-indigo-500" 
                            />
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0 bg-slate-950/30 p-0.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-900">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setFoldRatio(1.0);
                                setIsFoldingAnimPlaying(false);
                              }}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all font-bold border cursor-pointer ${foldRatio === 1.0 ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-400 text-white shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-950/80 border-slate-850/70 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
                            >
                              بستن (100%)
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setFoldRatio(0.5);
                                setIsFoldingAnimPlaying(false);
                              }}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all font-bold border cursor-pointer ${foldRatio === 0.5 ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-450 text-white shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-950/80 border-slate-850/70 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
                            >
                              مونتاژ (50%)
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setFoldRatio(0.05);
                                setIsFoldingAnimPlaying(false);
                              }}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all font-bold border cursor-pointer ${foldRatio === 0.05 ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-400 text-white shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-950/80 border-slate-850/70 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
                            >
                              باز کامل (5%)
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setFoldRatio(-1.0);
                                setIsFoldingAnimPlaying(false);
                              }}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all font-bold border cursor-pointer ${foldRatio === -1.0 ? 'bg-rose-950 border-rose-500/50 text-rose-350' : 'bg-slate-950/80 border-slate-850/70 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-455'}`}
                            >
                              معکوس
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 2: flap bent directions */}
                        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-2 px-3 border-r border-l border-slate-800/80 w-full lg:w-auto">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 font-sans whitespace-nowrap">خم درب‌ها:</span>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 sm:flex gap-1 w-full sm:w-auto">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setFlapDirections(prev => ({ ...prev, top: prev.top === 'inside' ? 'outside' : 'inside' }))}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] py-1.5 px-1.5 sm:px-2 rounded-lg border transition-all text-center font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                                flapDirections.top === 'outside' ? 'bg-indigo-950/85 border-indigo-500/80 text-indigo-300' : 'bg-[#090c11] border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                              }`}
                              title="درب بالا"
                            >
                              <span>بالا {flapDirections.top === 'outside' ? '↗' : '↙'}</span>
                            </button>

                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setFlapDirections(prev => ({ ...prev, bottom: prev.bottom === 'inside' ? 'outside' : 'inside' }))}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] py-1.5 px-1.5 sm:px-2 rounded-lg border transition-all text-center font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                                flapDirections.bottom === 'outside' ? 'bg-[#09353a] border-cyan-500/80 text-cyan-300' : 'bg-[#090c11] border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                              }`}
                              title="درب پایین"
                            >
                              <span>پایین {flapDirections.bottom === 'outside' ? '↘' : '↖'}</span>
                            </button>

                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setFlapDirections(prev => ({ ...prev, left: prev.left === 'inside' ? 'outside' : 'inside' }))}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] py-1.5 px-1.5 sm:px-2 rounded-lg border transition-all text-center font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                                flapDirections.left === 'outside' ? 'bg-violet-950/85 border-violet-500/80 text-violet-300' : 'bg-[#090c11] border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                              }`}
                              title="درب چپ"
                            >
                              <span>چپ {flapDirections.left === 'outside' ? '←' : '→'}</span>
                            </button>

                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setFlapDirections(prev => ({ ...prev, right: prev.right === 'inside' ? 'outside' : 'inside' }))}
                              className={`text-[8.5px] py-1.5 px-1.5 sm:px-2 rounded-lg border transition-all text-center font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                                flapDirections.right === 'outside' ? 'bg-pink-950/85 border-pink-500/80 text-pink-300' : 'bg-[#090c11] border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                              }`}
                              title="درب راست"
                            >
                              <span>راست {flapDirections.right === 'outside' ? '→' : '←'}</span>
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Section 3: actions & camera */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full lg:w-auto justify-end pr-1 lg:pr-0 pl-1">
                          <button 
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setAutoRotate(!autoRotate)} 
                            className={`text-[8.5px] py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg border font-bold transition-all text-center cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${autoRotate ? 'bg-[#0284c7] border-sky-500 text-white shadow-sm' : 'bg-[#0d141d]/75 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
                            title="چرخش پیوسته"
                          >
                            چرخش آزاد
                          </button>

                          <button 
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setCameraOrbit(!cameraOrbit)} 
                            className={`text-[8.5px] py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg border font-bold transition-all text-center cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${cameraOrbit ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 text-white shadow-sm' : 'bg-[#0d141d]/75 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
                            title="گردش دوربین"
                          >
                            دورانی
                          </button>

                          <button

                    <div className="w-full max-w-4xl max-h-full aspect-video flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                      
                      {modalViewMode === 'sheet' ? (
                        /* --- SHEET MAP DISPLAY --- */
                        (() => {
                          const sw = sheetSize.width;
                          const sh = sheetSize.height;
                          const itemW = dieline.totalW;
                          const itemH = dieline.totalH;
                          
                          const overlapOffset = layoutAlgorithm === 'nested_optimized' ? 0.92 : 1.0;
                          const gap = nestingGap;
                          
                          // Arrangement grid layout
                          let cols = Math.floor(sw / (itemW + gap));
                          let rows = Math.floor(sh / (itemH + gap));
                          if (cols === 0) cols = 1;
                          if (rows === 0) rows = 1;
                          
                          const colsRot = Math.floor(sw / (itemH + gap));
                          const rowsRot = Math.floor(sh / (itemW + gap));
                          const useRotation = (colsRot * rowsRot) > (cols * rows);
                          
                          const finalCols = useRotation ? colsRot : cols;
                          const finalRows = useRotation ? rowsRot : rows;
                          
                          const countToRender = nestingResult.yieldCount;
                          const gridItems: { tx: number, ty: number, rotate: boolean, index: number }[] = [];
                          
                          for (let i = 0; i < countToRender; i++) {
                            const r = Math.floor(i / finalCols);
                            const c = i % finalCols;
                            
                            let tx = c * (useRotation ? itemH + gap : itemW + gap) * overlapOffset + 25;
                            let ty = r * (useRotation ? itemW + gap : itemH + gap) * overlapOffset + 25;
                            
                            // Alternate offset for interlocking simulation!
                            if (layoutAlgorithm === 'nested_optimized' && r % 2 === 1) {
                              tx += (useRotation ? itemH + gap : itemW + gap) * 0.12;
                            }
                            
                            gridItems.push({ tx, ty, rotate: useRotation, index: i });
                          }

                          return (
                            <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-between p-2">
                              <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-center text-[10px] mb-2 font-mono uppercase bg-[#162a22]/30 border border-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-400 py-1 rounded-lg">
                                {layoutAlgorithm === 'standard' ? 'GRID LAYOUT FORM (بدون همپوشانی ردیف)' : 'INTERLACING CAD LAYOUT (آلانه‌سازی فعال)'}
                              </h4>
                              
                              <svg 
                                viewBox={`0 0 ${sw + 50} ${sh + 50}`} 
                                className="w-full h-full object-contain filter drop-shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]"
                              >
                                <defs>
                                  <g id="modal-sheet-single-element">
                                    {/* Creases */}
                                    {dieline.creases.map((pathStr, index) => (
                                      <path 
                                        key={`mscr-${index}`} 
                                        d={pathStr} 
                                        stroke="#dc2626" 
                                        strokeWidth="1.0" 
                                        strokeDasharray="2,2" 
                                        fill="none" 
                                        opacity="0.7" 
                                      />
                                    ))}
                                    {/* Cuts */}
                                    {dieline.cuts.map((pathStr, index) => (
                                      <path 
                                        key={`msct-${index}`} 
                                        d={pathStr} 
                                        stroke="#1e293b" 
                                        strokeWidth="1.1" 
                                        fill="none" 
                                      />
                                    ))}
                                  </g>
                                </defs>

                                {/* Background Sheet Border and boundaries */}
                                <rect 
                                  x="25" 
                                  y="25" 
                                  width={sw} 
                                  height={sh} 
                                  fill="#0a0f1d" 
                                  stroke="#334155" 
                                  strokeWidth="2" 
                                  rx="4"
                                />

                                {/* Internal printing safe boundary frame */}
                                <rect 
                                  x="35" 
                                  y="35" 
                                  width={sw - 20} 
                                  height={sh - 20} 
                                  fill="none" 
                                  stroke="#10b981" 
                                  strokeWidth="1.2" 
                                  strokeDasharray="3,3" 
                                  opacity="0.4"
                                />

                                {/* Grid items with optional alternate offset rows */}
                                {gridItems.map((item) => {
                                  let transformStr = `translate(${item.tx}, ${item.ty})`;
                                  if (item.rotate) {
                                    transformStr += ` rotate(90) translate(0, ${-itemH})`;
                                  }

                                  return (
                                    <g key={`sh-item-${item.index}`} transform={transformStr}>
                                      <rect 
                                        x="0" 
                                        y="0" 
                                        width={itemW} 
                                        height={itemH} 
                                        fill="#6366f1" 
                                        fillOpacity="0.08" 
                                        stroke="#4338ca" 
                                        strokeWidth="0.5" 
                                        strokeDasharray="2,3" 
                                        rx="2"
                                      />
                                      <g transform={`translate(${-dieline.xMin}, ${-dieline.yMin})`}>
                                        <use href="#modal-sheet-single-element" />
                                      </g>
                                      
                                      <g transform={`translate(${itemW / 2}, ${itemH / 2})`}>
                                        <circle r="9" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="1" />
                                        <text y="3" textAnchor="middle" fill="#38bdf8" fontSize="8" fontWeight="bold" className="font-mono">
                                          {item.index + 1}
                                        </text>
                                      </g>
                                    </g>
                                  );
                                })}

                                {/* Measurement legends */}
                                <text x={(sw + 40)/2} y={sh + 14} textAnchor="middle" fill="#94a3b8" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold" className="font-sans">
                                  عرض شیت: {sw} میلی‌متر
                                </text>
                                <text x="35" y={(sh + 40)/2} textAnchor="middle" fill="#94a3b8" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold" transform={`rotate(-90 35 ${(sh+40)/2})`} className="font-sans">
                                  ارتفاع شیت: {sh} میلی‌متر
                                </text>
                              </svg>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })()
                      ) : (
                        /* --- SINGLE CAD BluePrint MAP DISPLAY --- */
                        <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-between p-2">
                          <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-center text-[10px] mb-2 font-mono uppercase bg-[#1e2d42]/30 border border-slate-800/30 text-sky-400 py-1 rounded-lg">
                            CAD Blueprint Vector - تک قالب جهت دایکات
                          </h4>
                          
                          <svg 
                            viewBox={`${dieline.xMin - 60} ${dieline.yMin - 60} ${dieline.totalW + 120} ${dieline.totalH + 120}`} 
                            className="w-full h-full object-contain filter drop-shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]"
                          >
                            {/* Blue print Canvas backgrounds */}
                            <rect 
                              x={dieline.xMin - 60} 
                              y={dieline.yMin - 60} 
                              width={dieline.totalW + 120} 
                              height={dieline.totalH + 120} 
                              fill="#070b13" 
                              stroke="#1e293b" 
                              strokeWidth="1" 
                              rx="8"
                            />

                            {/* Creases */}
                            {dieline.creases.map((pathStr, index) => (
                              <path 
                                key={`mod-cad-crease-${index}`} 
                                d={pathStr} 
                                stroke="#f59e0b" 
                                strokeWidth="1.2" 
                                strokeDasharray="3,3" 
                                fill="none" 
                              />
                            ))}

                            {/* Cuts */}
                            {dieline.cuts.map((pathStr, index) => (
                              <path 
                                key={`mod-cad-cut-${index}`} 
                                d={pathStr} 
                                stroke="#14b8a6" 
                                strokeWidth="1.5" 
                                fill="none" 
                              />
                            ))}
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                      )}

                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Informative info strip alert */}
                  <div className="p-3 bg-[#0a0f1d] border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-[9.5px]" dir="rtl">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
                      <span>مهندسی خط‌تیغ منطبق با استانداردهای کارتن‌سازی و جعبه‌سازی ایران. محاسبات شامل خلاصی فلپ‌ها می‌باشد.</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-[#cbd5e1] font-mono bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-900/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">AUTO SYNCHRONIZED ERP</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* 3D Static PNG Snapshot Preview Modal Overlay */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {previewingSnapshot && (

            >

              <button

              </button>

              {/* Header */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5 pb-3 border-b border-slate-800 text-right">

                  <Camera className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400 animate-pulse" />

                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 font-sans">خروجی زنده استودیوی خلاق بوم سه‌بعدی اشک قلم</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Image Preview Container with pattern grid */}
              <div className="flex-1 min-h-[220px] max-h-[360px] bg-[#04060b] border border-slate-850 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative flex items-center justify-center p-4 shadow-inner group">

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { normalizePersianNumbers } from '../utils/numberUtils';

interface DimensionInputProps {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  unit: 'mm' | 'cm' | 'inches';
  onChange: (valInMm: number) => void;
  convertMmToUnit: (v: number, u: 'mm' | 'cm' | 'inches') => number;
  convertUnitToMm: (v: number, u: 'mm' | 'cm' | 'inches') => number;
  className?: string;
  inputClassName?: string;
}

export const DimensionInput: React.FC<DimensionInputProps> = ({ 
  label, 
  value, 
  unit, 
  onChange, 
  convertMmToUnit, 
  convertUnitToMm,
  className = "flex items-center justify-between gap-4",
  inputClassName = "w-24 bg-[#070a0e] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg py-1.5 px-3 text-center text-xs font-mono text-sky-400 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-sky-500 transition-all font-bold"
}) => {
  const [localVal, setLocalVal] = useState<string>(String(convertMmToUnit(value, unit)));

  useEffect(() => {
    const newParsed = convertMmToUnit(value, unit);
    const currentParsed = parseFloat(normalizePersianNumbers(localVal));
    if (isNaN(currentParsed) || currentParsed !== newParsed) {
      setLocalVal(String(newParsed));
    }
  }, [value, unit]);

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const rawVal = e.target.value;
    const englishVal = normalizePersianNumbers(rawVal);
    
    // Input Mask: Only allow numbers and decimal point
    if (!/^[\d]*\.?[\d]*$/.test(englishVal) && englishVal !== '-') {
      return;
    }

    setLocalVal(rawVal);
    
    if (englishVal === '' || englishVal === '-') {
      return;
    }

    const parsed = parseFloat(englishVal);
    if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
      onChange(convertUnitToMm(parsed, unit));
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const current = parseFloat(normalizePersianNumbers(localVal));
      if (isNaN(current)) return;
      const step = unit === 'mm' ? 1 : (unit === 'cm' ? 0.1 : 0.05);
      const direction = e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? 1 : -1;
      
      const newVal = Math.max(0, current + (step * direction));
      // Format cleanly to 2 decimal places max to avoid floats like 1.100000000001
      const cleanVal = parseFloat(newVal.toFixed(2));
      
      setLocalVal(String(cleanVal));
      onChange(convertUnitToMm(cleanVal, unit));
    }
  };

  const handleBlur = () => {
    const englishVal = normalizePersianNumbers(localVal);
    let parsed = parseFloat(englishVal);
    if (isNaN(parsed)) {
      parsed = convertMmToUnit(value, unit);
    }
    const clamped = Math.max(10, convertUnitToMm(parsed, unit));
    setLocalVal(String(convertMmToUnit(clamped, unit)));
    onChange(clamped);
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {label && <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex-1">{label}</span>}
      <input
        type="text"
        inputMode="decimal"
        value={localVal}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        dir="ltr"
        className={inputClassName}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useContext, createContext } from 'react';

export const AnchorContext = createContext<'left' | 'right' | undefined>(undefined);

interface DockableWindowProps {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: React.ElementType;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialX: number;
  initialY: number;
  initialWidth?: number;
  initialHeight?: number;

export const DockableWindow: React.FC<DockableWindowProps> = ({

  title,

  isOpen,
  onClose,
  children,
  initialX,
  initialY,
  initialWidth = 340,
  initialHeight = 400,
  containerRef,
  zIndex,
  onFocus,
  isMobile = false,
  inlinePopoverAnchor: inlineAnchorProp,
}) => {
  const contextAnchor = useContext(AnchorContext);
  const inlinePopoverAnchor = inlineAnchorProp || contextAnchor;
  const [position, setPosition] = useState({ x: initialX, y: initialY });
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ width: initialWidth, height: initialHeight });
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState(false);
  const [isMaximized, setIsMaximized] = useState(false);
  const [dockSide, setDockSide] = useState<'left' | 'right' | null>(null);
  
  const windowRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const resizeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Sync with initial size changes or mobile status
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobile) {
      setIsMaximized(true);
      setDockSide(null);
    } else {
      setIsMaximized(false);
      setPosition({ x: initialX, y: initialY });
      setSize({ width: initialWidth, height: initialHeight });
    }
  }, [isMobile, initialX, initialY, initialWidth, initialHeight]);

  // Handle Dragging Constraint limit
  const handleDragEnd = (event: any, info: any) => {
    if (isMaximized || dockSide) return;
    const newX = position.x + info.delta.x;
    const newY = position.y + info.delta.y;
    setPosition({ x: newX, y: newY });
  };

  // Toggle maximize
  const toggleMaximize = () => {
    if (dockSide) setDockSide(null);
    setIsMaximized(!isMaximized);
    if (isMinimized) setIsMinimized(false);
    onFocus();
  };

  // Toggle minimize (collapse content but keep titlebar at bottom or as tiny bubble)
  const toggleMinimize = () => {
    setIsMinimized(!isMinimized);
    if (isMaximized) setIsMaximized(false);
    onFocus();
  };

  // Dock Left
  const dockLeft = () => {
    if (dockSide === 'left') {
      setDockSide(null);
    } else {
      setDockSide('left');
      setIsMaximized(false);
      setIsMinimized(false);
    }
    onFocus();
  };

  // Dock Right
  const dockRight = () => {
    if (dockSide === 'right') {
      setDockSide(null);
    } else {
      setDockSide('right');
      setIsMaximized(false);
      setIsMinimized(false);
    }
    onFocus();
  };

  // Dynamic Styles base on window state
  const getWindowStateClassesAndStyles = () => {
    if (isMobile) {
      return {
        classes: "fixed inset-0 z-[100] w-full h-full rounded-none bg-slate-950/98",
        style: { zIndex: 9999 }
      };

    if (dockSide === 'left') {

    const startHeight = size.height;

      const deltaX = moveEvent.clientX - startX;
      const deltaY = moveEvent.clientY - startY;

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {IconComponent && <IconComponent className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400 shrink-0" />}
            <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-slate-100">{title}</span>
          </div>
          <button 
             onClick={onClose}
             className="p-1 hover:bg-rose-900/50 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto max-h-[calc(70vh-40px)] relative custom-scrollbar pointer-events-auto" dir="rtl">
          {children}

    >
      {/* WINDOW TITLE BAR */}

        onMouseDown={onFocus}

        } : {})}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 max-w-[50%]">
          {IconComponent && <IconComponent className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-454 shrink-0" />}
          <span className="text-[11px] font-black truncate text-slate-100 font-sans">{title}</span>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-auto" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
