```typescript
// =========================================================================
interface PropertyInspectorProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  zIndex: number;
  onFocus: () => void;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  specialEffect: string;
  setSpecialEffect: (fx: string) => void;
  pdfQuality: string;
  setPdfQuality: (quality: string) => void;
  lineWidthStyle: string;
  setLineWidthStyle: (style: string) => void;
  viewMode: string;
  foldRatio: number;
  setFoldRatio: (ratio: number) => void;
}

export const PropertyInspectorWindow: React.FC<PropertyInspectorProps> = ({
  isOpen, onClose, zIndex, onFocus, containerRef,
  specialEffect, setSpecialEffect, pdfQuality, setPdfQuality,
  lineWidthStyle, setLineWidthStyle, viewMode, foldRatio, setFoldRatio
}) => {
  // Accordion toggle state
  const [toggleSections, setToggleSections] = useState({
    industrial: true,
    drafting: true,
  });

  // Help tooltip states
  const [activeHelp, setActiveHelp] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const toggleSection = (sec: 'industrial' | 'drafting') => {
    setToggleSections(prev => ({ ...prev, [sec]: !prev[sec] }));
  };

  const getEngineeringHelp = (param: string) => {
    switch (param) {
      case 'fx':
        return 'جلوه‌ صنعتی (Industrial FX): انطباق یووی موضعی یا کلیشه فويل به حاشیه ۱.۵ میلی‌متری تخلیه چسب نیاز دارد تا روکش به درستی متصل شود.';
      case 'dpi':
        return 'کیفیت لایه‌برداری (DPI): رندر برداری بر اساس استاندارد خروجی چاپی PDF/X-1a جهت حفظ نهایت وضوح و ممانعت از رنجه شدن حاشیه ریز فونت‌ها.';
      case 'lineWidth':
        return 'ضخامت نقشه دایکات: پهنای خط تیغ برش بیرونی تمایز جدی با خطوط پلی‌استر ماتریس نیم‌تیغ‌زنی دارد تا خطا در قرائت نقشه توسط لیزر صفر شود.';
      case 'fold':
        return 'شبیه‌سازی سه لایه (ISO 2493): شبیه‌ساز رفتار الاستیک خمش وجوه در برابر گشتاور استاتیکی خمش؛ تسهیل فرآیند بسته‌بندی مکانیزه سرعت بالا.';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <DockableWindow
      id="property_inspector"
      title="ویژگی‌ها و افکت‌های اختصاصی"
      icon={Settings}
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      initialX={window.innerWidth - 380}
      initialY={80}
      zIndex={zIndex}
      onFocus={onFocus}
      containerRef={containerRef}
    >
      <div className="p-3.5 space-y-3 overflow-y-auto h-full text-right custom-scrollbar" dir="rtl">
        
        {/* Accordion 1: افکت‌های چاپی و صنعتی */}
        <div className="border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#070a0e]/40">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toggleSection('industrial')}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 bg-[#090d16] hover:bg-[#111724] transition-colors border-b border-slate-800"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-slate-200 font-sans-bold">جلوه‌های صنعتی فرآیند (FX Options)</span>
            </div>
            {toggleSections.industrial ? (
              <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            )}
          </button>

          {toggleSections.industrial && (
            <div className="p-3 space-y-3.5">
              
              {/* FX Special Effects */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-350 font-bold font-sans">افکت‌های چاپی و صنعتی:</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setActiveHelp(activeHelp === 'fx' ? null : 'fx')}
                      className={`p-0.5 rounded-full transition-all hover:bg-slate-800 ${activeHelp === 'fx' ? 'text-amber-450' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
                      title="راهنمای مهندسی"
                    >
                      <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                  {[
                    { id: 'none', label: 'خام بدون افکت' },
                    { id: 'gold_foil', label: 'طلاکوب متالایز' },
                    { id: 'uv_spot', label: 'UV موضعی برجسته' },
                    { id: 'both', label: 'طلاکوب + UV دوبل' }
                  ].map(eff => (
                    <button
                      key={eff.id}
                      onClick={() => setSpecialEffect(eff.id)}
                      className={`py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9.5px] font-bold border transition-all font-sans ${specialEffect === eff.id ? 'bg-amber-600 border-amber-400 text-white shadow-md font-black' : 'bg-[#030508]/60 border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-250'}`}
                      type="button"
                    >
                      {eff.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {activeHelp === 'fx' && (
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-900/60 text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans text-right animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <span className="text-amber-450 font-bold block mb-0.5">📘 استاندارد مرتبط:</span>
                    {getEngineeringHelp('fx')}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="h-px bg-slate-850"></div>

              {/* PDF Quality */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-350 font-bold font-sans">کیفیت لایه‌ برداری خروجی</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setActiveHelp(activeHelp === 'dpi' ? null : 'dpi')}
                      className={`p-0.5 rounded-full transition-all hover:bg-slate-800 ${activeHelp === 'dpi' ? 'text-indigo-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
                      title="راهنمای مهندسی"
                    >
                      <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[8.5px] font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold">{pdfQuality === 'high' ? '300 DPI' : '150 DPI'}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 p-0.5 bg-[#030508] border border-slate-850 rounded-lg">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setPdfQuality('standard')}
                    className={`py-1 rounded-md text-[8.5px] font-bold transition-all font-sans ${pdfQuality === 'standard' ? 'bg-[#1e293b] text-white font-black' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-350'}`}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    استارتدرد (150 DPI)
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setPdfQuality('high')}
                    className={`py-1 rounded-md text-[8.5px] font-bold transition-all font-sans ${pdfQuality === 'high' ? 'bg-[#1e293b] text-white font-black' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-350'}`}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    عالی (300 DPI)
                  </button>
                </div>

                {activeHelp === 'dpi' && (
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-950/20 border border-indigo-900/60 text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans text-right animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <span className="text-indigo-450 font-bold block mb-0.5">📘 استاندارد مرتبط:</span>
                    {getEngineeringHelp('dpi')}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Accordion 2: ابزارهای رسم و کنترل فیزیکی */}
        <div className="border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#070a0e]/40">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toggleSection('drafting')}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 bg-[#090d16] hover:bg-[#111724] transition-colors border-b border-slate-800"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <RulerIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-slate-200 font-sans-bold">ضوابط نقشه و ترسیم (Drafting)</span>
            </div>
            {toggleSections.drafting ? (
              <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            )}
          </button>

          {toggleSections.drafting && (
            <div className="p-3 space-y-3.5">
              
              {/* Line thickness */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-350 font-bold font-sans">ضخامت قلم ترسیم لایه‌ها</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setActiveHelp(activeHelp === 'lineWidth' ? null : 'lineWidth')}
                      className={`p-0.5 rounded-full transition-all hover:bg-slate-800 ${activeHelp === 'lineWidth' ? 'text-sky-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
                      title="راهنمای مهندسی"
                    >
                      <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[8.5px] font-mono text-sky-400 font-bold">{lineWidthStyle === 'bold' ? 'ضخیم' : 'ظریف'}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 p-0.5 bg-[#030508] border border-slate-850 rounded-lg">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setLineWidthStyle('standard')}
                    className={`py-1 rounded-md text-[8.5px] font-bold transition-all font-sans ${lineWidthStyle === 'standard' ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-550 hover:text-slate-450'}`}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    معمولی (0.3mm)
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setLineWidthStyle('bold')}
                    className={`py-1 rounded-md text-[8.5px] font-bold transition-all font-sans ${lineWidthStyle === 'bold' ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-550 hover:text-slate-450'}`}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    ضخیم (0.6mm)
                  </button>
                </div>

                {activeHelp === 'lineWidth' && (
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-950/20 border border-sky-900/60 text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans text-right animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <span className="text-sky-450 font-bold block mb-0.5">📘 استاندارد مرتبط:</span>
                    {getEngineeringHelp('lineWidth')}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Fold angle slider */}
              {viewMode === '3d' && (
                <>
                  <div className="h-px bg-slate-850"></div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-350 font-bold font-sans">زاویه تا خوردن وجوه سه بعدی</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setActiveHelp(activeHelp === 'fold' ? null : 'fold')}
                          className={`p-0.5 rounded-full transition-all hover:bg-slate-800 ${activeHelp === 'fold' ? 'text-sky-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
                          title="راهنمای مهندسی"
                        >
                          <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[8.5px] font-mono text-indigo-400 font-bold">{Math.round(foldRatio * 100)}%</span>
                    </div>

                    <input 
                      type="range" 
                      min="-1" 
                      max="1" 
                      step="0.01" 
                      value={foldRatio} 
                      onChange={e => setFoldRatio(parseFloat(e.target.value))} 
                      className="w-full h-1 bg-slate-850 rounded appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-sky-500" 
                    />

                    {activeHelp === 'fold' && (
                      <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-950/20 border border-indigo-900/60 text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans text-right animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                        <span className="text-indigo-450 font-bold block mb-0.5">📘 استاندارد مرتبط:</span>
                        {getEngineeringHelp('fold')}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </DockableWindow>
  );
};

// =========================================================================
// 5. LAYERS PANEL WINDOW
// =========================================================================
interface LayerItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  isVisible: boolean;
  isLocked: boolean;
  type: string;
}

interface LayersPanelProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  zIndex: number;
  onFocus: () => void;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  layers: LayerItem[];
  setLayers: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<LayerItem[]>>;
  snapToGrid: boolean;
  setSnapToGrid: (snap: boolean) => void;
  bleedOffset: number;
  setBleedOffset: (b: number) => void;
}

export const LayersPanelWindow: React.FC<LayersPanelProps> = ({
  isOpen, onClose, zIndex, onFocus, containerRef,
  layers, setLayers, snapToGrid, setSnapToGrid,
  bleedOffset, setBleedOffset
}) => {
  return (
    <DockableWindow
      id="layers_panel"
      title="مدیریت لایه‌ها و شابلون‌ها (Layers)"
      icon={Layers3}
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      initialX={window.innerWidth - 380}
      initialY={430}
      zIndex={zIndex}
      onFocus={onFocus}
      containerRef={containerRef}
    >
      <div className="p-4 space-y-3 overflow-y-auto h-full text-right animate-in fade-in" dir="rtl font-sans">
        <span className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 block mb-2 font-bold font-sans">کنترل وضعیت قفل و دید لایه‌ها:</span>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {layers.map(layer => (
            <div key={layer.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#070a0e]/60 border border-slate-800 text-[10px] font-sans">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: layer.color }}></div>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">{layer.name}</span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setLayers(prev => prev.map(l => l.id === layer.id ? { ...l, isVisible: !l.isVisible } : l));
                  }}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[8.5px] font-black transition-all ${layer.isVisible ? 'bg-sky-950 text-sky-400 border border-sky-850' : 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-600 border border-slate-900'}`}
                >
                  {layer.isVisible ? 'پیدا' : 'پنهان'}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setLayers(prev => prev.map(l => l.id === layer.id ? { ...l, isLocked: !l.isLocked } : l));
                  }}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[8.5px] font-black transition-all ${layer.isLocked ? 'bg-amber-950 text-amber-500 border border-amber-900' : 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-600 border border-slate-900'}`}
                >
                  {layer.isLocked ? 'قفل صلب' : 'آزاد'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="p-2.5 bg-[#090b12] rounded-xl border border-slate-800/60 mt-2 flex items-center justify-between font-sans">
          <span className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500">جذب باینری به خطوط شبکه کاد:</span>
          <input 
            type="checkbox"
            checked={snapToGrid}
            onChange={e => setSnapToGrid(e.target.checked)}
            className="w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-indigo-500 cursor-pointer"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Bleed Offset slider inside Layers panel */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-[#090b12]/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800/60 space-y-2 font-sans">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-350 font-bold">میزان محدوده آفست چسب زبانه (Bleed):</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-sky-400 font-mono font-bold font-sans">{bleedOffset}mm</span>
          </div>
          <input 
            type="range" 
            min="0" 
            max="80" 
            value={bleedOffset} 
            onChange={e => setBleedOffset(Number(e.target.value))} 
            className="w-full h-1 bg-slate-850 rounded appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-indigo-500 border-none" 
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </DockableWindow>
  );
};

          >

          </button>

            className="w-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-750 text-[10px] py-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 border border-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
          >

// =========================================================================
// 7. PHYSICS & TECHNICAL COMPRESSION WINDOW
// =========================================================================
interface PhysicsReport {
  isSafe: boolean;
  bctKg: number;
  safetyFactor: number;
  requiredResistance: number;
  strengthBCT?: number;
}

interface GeometryReport {
  score: number;
  passed: boolean;
  cutLength: number;
  creaseLength: number;
  glueArea: number;
  bleedArea: number;
  materialUsage: number;
}

interface PhysicsReportsProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  zIndex: number;
  onFocus: () => void;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  productWeight: number;
  setProductWeight: (w: number) => void;
  shelfHumidity: number;
  setShelfHumidity: (h: number) => void;
  stackHeight: number;
  setStackHeight: (s: number) => void;
  physicsReport: PhysicsReport;
  geometryReport: GeometryReport;
}

export const PhysicsReportsWindow: React.FC<PhysicsReportsProps> = ({
  isOpen, onClose, zIndex, onFocus, containerRef,
  productWeight, setProductWeight, shelfHumidity, setShelfHumidity, stackHeight, setStackHeight,
  physicsReport, geometryReport
}) => {
  return (
    <DockableWindow
      id="physics_reports"
      title="پایش مکانیک و مقاومت کارتن (McKee BCT)"
      icon={Info}
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      initialX={250}
      initialY={220}
      zIndex={zIndex}
      onFocus={onFocus}
      containerRef={containerRef}
    >
      <div className="p-4 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto h-full text-right" dir="rtl">
        <div className="space-y-3.5 font-sans">
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold">
              <span>وزن هر محصول داخل جعبه (Product Weight):</span>
              <span className="text-white font-bold">{productWeight} کیلوگرم</span>
            </div>
            <input 
              type="range" 
              min="0.1" 
              max="10" 
              step="0.1" 
              value={productWeight} 
              onChange={e => setProductWeight(parseFloat(e.target.value))} 
              className="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800 rounded appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-amber-500"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold">
              <span>رطوبت انبارداری (Shelving Humidity RH%):</span>
              <span className="text-white font-bold">{shelfHumidity}٪ درصد</span>
            </div>
            <input 
              type="range" 
              min="10" 
              max="95" 
              value={shelfHumidity} 
              onChange={e => setShelfHumidity(parseInt(e.target.value))} 
              className="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800 rounded appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-indigo-505"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold">
              <span>ارتفاع چیدمان ستونی دایکات:</span>
              <span className="text-white font-bold">{stackHeight} طبقه روی هم</span>
            </div>
            <input 
              type="range" 
              min="2" 
              max="30" 
              value={stackHeight} 
              onChange={e => setStackHeight(parseInt(e.target.value))} 
              className="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800 rounded appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {physicsReport && (

          </div>

  );
};

interface ValidatorIssue {

}

interface GeometryWarningsProps {

export const GeometryWarningsWindow: React.FC<GeometryWarningsProps> = ({

}) => {

    <DockableWindow
      id="geometry_warnings"

      initialY={window.innerHeight - 380}
      zIndex={zIndex}
      onFocus={onFocus}
      containerRef={containerRef}
    >
      <div className="p-4 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto h-full text-right" dir="rtl">

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className={`text-xl font-extrabold font-mono ${geometryReport.score >= 95 ? 'text-emerald-450' : 'text-rose-450'}`}>{geometryReport.score}%</span>
            <Badge color={geometryReport.passed ? 'green' : 'red'}>{geometryReport.passed ? 'تایید تولید' : 'مسدود شده'}</Badge>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-h-0">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase block font-sans">گزارش نقایص هندسی و ساختاری:</span>
          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
            {validatorIssues.map((v, idx) => (
              <div key={idx} className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border flex gap-2 text-[10.5px] font-sans ${v.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-950/20 border-red-900/40 text-red-400' : 'bg-amber-950/15 border-amber-900/40 text-amber-500'}`}>
                <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0 mt-1 ${v.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-500 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-450'}`} />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-extrabold">{v.type === 'error' ? 'خطای فنی ساختاری' : 'تذکر انطباق دایکات'}</div>
                  <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 leading-normal mt-1">{v.msg}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
            {validatorIssues.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-6 text-[10.5px] text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-950/10 border border-emerald-900/30 rounded-xl leading-normal font-sans">
                🏆 رسم هندسی دایلاین اتمی و کاملاً فنی است و برای خروجی لیتوگرافی و قالب‌سازی ممتاز ارزیابی می‌شود.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </DockableWindow>
  );
};

            />

            >
              ثبت نسخه

        <div className="space-y-2 flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto pr-1">

                    onClick={() => {

                    className="absolute inset-0 bg-indigo-950/80 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] text-white font-black rounded transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    دانلود تصویر 📥
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </DockableWindow>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

import { calculatePrice, PricingParams, PriceResult } from '../services/pricingService';
import { ThreeDPreview } from './ThreeDPreview';
import { extractOrderDetails } from '../services/geminiService';
import { useContent } from '../contexts/ContentContext';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { loginGuest } from '../services/authService';
import { FileAnalyzer } from './FileAnalyzer';

// --- Constants & Data ---

const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: 'business-card', title: 'کارت ویزیت', icon: CreditCard, desc: 'لمینت، سلفون، کتان و...' },

];

const PAPER_TYPES = [
  { id: 'glossy-300', title: 'گلاسه ۳۰۰ گرم', desc: 'استاندارد و براق، مناسب اکثر کارها' },
  { id: 'matte-300', title: 'مات ۳۰۰ گرم', desc: 'سطح بدون بازتاب نور، شیک و سنگین' },
  { id: 'linen', title: 'کتان بافت‌دار', desc: 'دارای بافت ریز، حس کلاسیک' },
  { id: 'kraft', title: 'کرافت نخودی', desc: 'دوستدار محیط زیست، ظاهر ارگانیک' },
  { id: 'cardboard-ip', title: 'ایندربرد بهداشتی', desc: 'پشت سفید، مناسب جعبه دارو و غذا' },
];

const FINISHES = [
  { id: 'none', title: 'بدون روکش', price: '' },
  { id: 'matte', title: 'سلفون مات', price: '+۸۰۰ ت' },
  { id: 'glossy', title: 'سلفون براق', price: '+۷۰۰ ت' },
  { id: 'velvet', title: 'سلفون مخملی', price: '+۱۵۰۰ ت' },
];

const EXTRAS = [
  { id: 'rounded-corners', title: 'دورگرد (Round)', icon: Scissors },

  { id: 'gold-foil', title: 'طلاکوب', icon: Zap },
];

export const Inquiry: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, login } = useAuth();
  const { pricingFormula } = useContent(); 
  
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  // Guest Form State
  const [guestName, setGuestName] = useState('');
  const [guestPhone, setGuestPhone] = useState('');

  // Smart Fill State
  const [smartInput, setSmartInput] = useState('');
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);

  // File Upload State
  const [uploadedFile, setUploadedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [isFileValid, setIsFileValid] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Form State
  const [params, setParams] = useState<PricingParams>({
    category: 'business-card',
    size: '8.5x4.8',
    paperType: 'glossy-300',
    quantity: 1000,
    sides: 'single',
    laminate: 'matte',
    extras: [],
    deliverySpeed: 'normal',
  });

  // Price State
  const [price, setPrice] = useState<PriceResult | null>(null);

  // Recalculate price
  useEffect(() => {
    const result = calculatePrice(params, pricingFormula);
    setPrice(result);
  }, [params, pricingFormula]);

  const handleExtraToggle = (id: string) => {
    setParams(prev => {
      const exists = prev.extras.includes(id);
      return {
        ...prev,
        extras: exists ? prev.extras.filter(e => e !== id) : [...prev.extras, id]
      };
    });
  };

  const handleSmartFill = async () => {
    if (!smartInput.trim()) return;
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    
    try {
      const result = await extractOrderDetails(smartInput);
      if (result) {
        setParams(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          category: result.category !== 'other' ? result.category : prev.category,
          quantity: result.quantity || prev.quantity,
          paperType: result.paperType || prev.paperType,
        }));
        if (result.category !== 'other') setStep(2);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    // Validation for step 3
    if (step === 3 && uploadedFile && !isFileValid) {
       alert("لطفا ابتدا خطاهای فایل را بررسی کنید.");
       return;
    }

    if (step === 3) {
      setStep(4);
    } else {
      setStep(s => Math.min(s + 1, 4));
    }
  };

  const handleGuestSubmit = async () => {
    if (!guestName || !guestPhone) return;
    // Create a temporary guest session
    const guestUser = await loginGuest();
    guestUser.name = guestName;
    guestUser.phone = guestPhone;
    login(guestUser);
    setIsSuccess(true);
  };

  const handleAuthenticatedSubmit = () => {
    setIsSuccess(true);
  };

  const prevStep = () => setStep(s => Math.max(s - 1, 1));

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      setUploadedFile(e.target.files[0]);
      setIsFileValid(false); // Reset validity until analyzed
    }
  };

  const getTargetDims = () => {
     // Helper to pass dimensions to analyzer
     if (params.size === '8.5x4.8') return { w: 8.5, h: 4.8 };
     if (params.size === '9x6') return { w: 9, h: 6 };
     if (params.size === 'A5') return { w: 14.8, h: 21 };
     if (params.size === 'A4') return { w: 21, h: 29.7 };
     return { w: 10, h: 10 }; // Default
  };

  // --- Render Steps ---

  const renderSmartFill = () => (
    <div className="mb-8 p-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 via-pink-500 to-red-500 rounded-xl shadow-lg animate-in slide-in-from-top-4">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/30 text-purple-600 rounded-lg">
            <Sparkles className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-1">سفارش سریع با هوش مصنوعی</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-3">سفارش خود را به زبان ساده بنویسید تا فرم خودکار پر شود.</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input 
                value={smartInput}
                onChange={(e) => setSmartInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="مثال: ۱۰۰۰ عدد کارت ویزیت گلاسه مات برای شرکت..."
                className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 outline-none"
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSmartFill()}
              />
              <Button 
                onClick={handleSmartFill} 
                isLoading={isAnalyzing}
                disabled={!smartInput}
                className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
              >
                تحلیل و ثبت
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const renderProductSelection = () => (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in slide-in-from-right-4 duration-500">
      {renderSmartFill()}
      <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-white">انتخاب محصول</h2>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {CATEGORIES.map(cat => (
          <div 
            key={cat.id}
            onClick={() => { setParams({ ...params, category: cat.id as any }); handleNext(); }}
            className={`cursor-pointer rounded-xl border-2 p-4 flex flex-col items-center text-center transition-all hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 ${
              params.category === cat.id ? 'border-primary-500 bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20' : 'border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800'
            }`}
          >
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-full mb-3 ${params.category === cat.id ? 'bg-primary-100 text-primary-600' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'}`}>
              <cat.icon className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200">{cat.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{cat.desc}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const renderConfiguration = () => (
    <div className="space-y-8 animate-in slide-in-from-right-4 duration-500">
      {/* 1. Paper Type */}
      <section>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xs">1</span>
          جنس کاغذ
        </h3>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
           {PAPER_TYPES.map(paper => (
             <div 
               key={paper.id}
               onClick={() => setParams({ ...params, paperType: paper.id })}

  return (
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Unlock, Layers, Layers3 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface LayerState {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  isVisible: boolean;
  isLocked: boolean;
  type: string;
}

interface LayerManagerProps {
  layers: LayerState[];
  onToggleVisibility: (id: string) => void;
  onToggleLock: (id: string) => void;
}

export const LayerManager: React.FC<LayerManagerProps> = ({
  layers,
  onToggleVisibility,
  onToggleLock,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 font-sans" dir="rtl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-800/80 pb-2 mb-1">
        <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide">مدیریت لایه‌های هولوگرام CAD</span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
        {layers.map((layer) => (
          <div 
            key={layer.id}
            className={`flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg border transition-all ${layer.isVisible ? 'bg-slate-900/30 border-slate-850' : 'bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-950 opacity-40'}`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div 
                className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border border-black/35"
                style={{ backgroundColor: layer.color }}
              />
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${layer.isVisible ? 'text-slate-200' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
                {layer.name}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {/* Visibility Toggle */}
              <button
                onClick={() => onToggleVisibility(layer.id)}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-colors ${layer.isVisible ? 'text-sky-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
                title={layer.isVisible ? 'پنهان‌سازی لایه' : 'نمایش لایه'}
              >
                {layer.isVisible ? <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              </button>

              {/* Lock Toggle */}
              <button
                onClick={() => onToggleLock(layer.id)}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-colors ${layer.isLocked ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
                title={layer.isLocked ? 'باز کردن قفل' : 'قفل کردن لایه'}
              >
                {layer.isLocked ? <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      
      <div className="text-[7.5px] text-slate-500 flex justify-between px-1 border-t border-slate-850 pt-2 font-mono">
        <span>تعداد لایه‌ها: {layers.length} لایه پویا</span>
        <span>استاندارد لیتوگرافی: CMYK Vector</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { loginUser, registerUser, loginGuest } from '../services/authService';
import { Button, Card } from './UIComponents';
import { User, Lock, Mail, ArrowRight, Building, Upload, Camera } from 'lucide-react';
import { UserRole } from '../types';

interface LoginProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
  onLoginSuccess?: (user: any) => void;
  targetRole?: UserRole; // Optional: Enforce specific role login (e.g., Admin)
}

export const Login: React.FC<LoginProps> = ({ onBack, onLoginSuccess, targetRole }) => {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [isLogin, setIsLogin] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // Form State
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [companyName, setCompanyName] = useState('');
  const [avatarPreview, setAvatarPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleSuccess = (user: any) => {
    if (targetRole && user.role !== targetRole) {
      setError('دسترسی غیرمجاز: شما اجازه ورود به این بخش را ندارید.');
      return;
    }
    // Inject avatar if uploaded during registration
    if (!isLogin && avatarPreview) {
        user.avatar = avatarPreview;
    }
    login(user);
    if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(user);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      if (isLogin) {
        const res = await loginUser(username, password);
        if (res.success && res.user) {
          handleSuccess(res.user);
        } else {
          setError(res.error || 'خطا در ورود');
        }
      } else {
        const res = await registerUser({ name, username, password, companyName });
        if (res.success && res.user) {
          handleSuccess(res.user);
        } else {
          setError('خطا در ثبت نام');
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('خطای سرور');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGuest = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const user = await loginGuest();
    handleSuccess(user);
  };

  const handleAvatarUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (file) {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = (ev) => {
              setAvatarPreview(ev.target?.result as string);
          };
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-900 p-4 relative">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('https://picsum.photos/1920/1080?blur=5')] bg-cover bg-center opacity-10"></div>
      
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md p-8 relative z-10 shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-300">
        {onBack && (
          <button 
            onClick={onBack}
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-200 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 text-xs"
          >
            <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" /> بازگشت به سایت
          </button>
        )}

        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-primary-600 rounded-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center mb-4 text-white text-2xl font-bold shadow-lg shadow-primary-500/40">
            ا
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2">
            {targetRole === UserRole.ADMIN ? 'ورود مدیران سیستم' : (isLogin ? 'ورود به اشک قلم' : 'ایجاد حساب جدید')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm">
            {targetRole === UserRole.ADMIN 
              ? 'لطفا برای دسترسی به پنل مدیریت وارد شوید'
              : (isLogin ? 'برای دسترسی به پنل کاربری وارد شوید' : 'پروفایل خود را بسازید و شروع کنید')
            }
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-3 rounded-lg text-sm mb-4 text-center border border-red-100">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          {!isLogin && !targetRole && (
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';

interface MiniMapProps {
  cuts: string[];
  creases: string[];
  dielineBounds: { xMin: number; xMax: number; totalW: number; totalH: number };
  pan: { x: number; y: number };
  zoomScale: number;
}

export const MiniMap: React.FC<MiniMapProps> = ({
  cuts,
  creases,
  dielineBounds,
  pan,
  zoomScale,
}) => {
  // Pad the viewport bounds
  const mapWidth = 120;
  const mapHeight = 100;

  const pad = 20;
  const scaleX = (mapWidth - pad) / (dielineBounds.totalW || 1);
  const scaleY = (mapHeight - pad) / (dielineBounds.totalH || 1);
  const scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY) || 0.2;

  // Center alignment offset
  const tx = (mapWidth - dielineBounds.totalW * scale) / 2 - dielineBounds.xMin * scale;
  const ty = (mapHeight - dielineBounds.totalH * scale) / 2 - dielineBounds.yMin * scale;

  return (
    <div className="absolute bottom-16 left-6 z-30 w-36 h-32 bg-[#080d19]/90 backdrop-blur border border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-xl p-1 select-none pointer-events-auto flex flex-col items-center justify-between">
      <span className="text-[7.5px] font-bold text-sky-400/80 font-mono tracking-wider uppercase mb-0.5">MINI-MAP NAVIGATOR</span>
      <div className="w-full flex-1 relative bg-[#04060b] rounded border border-slate-900/60 overflow-hidden">
        <svg 
          width="100%" 
          height="100%" 
          viewBox={`0 0 ${mapWidth} ${mapHeight}`}
          className="w-full h-full"
        >
          {/* Slices of dielines scaled down */}
          <g transform={`translate(${tx}, ${ty}) scale(${scale})`}>
            {/* Creases */}
            {creases.map((c, i) => (
              <path key={`m-crease-${i}`} d={c} stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeDasharray="5,5" fill="none" opacity="0.4" />
            ))}
            {/* Cuts */}
            {cuts.map((c, i) => (
              <path key={`m-cut-${i}`} d={c} stroke="#38bdf8" strokeWidth="4" fill="none" opacity="0.6" />
            ))}
          </g>

          {/* Canvas viewport simulated window block */}
          {/* We show where the current view center is */}
          <circle 
            cx={mapWidth / 2} 
            cy={mapHeight / 2} 
            r="8" 
            fill="none" 
            stroke="#ef4444" 
            strokeWidth="0.8" 
            className="animate-ping" 
          />
          <circle 
            cx={mapWidth / 2} 
            cy={mapHeight / 2} 
            r="2" 
            fill="#ef4444" 
          />
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div className="text-[7px] text-slate-500 font-mono flex justify-between w-full px-1.5 mt-0.5">
        <span>zoom: {Math.round(zoomScale * 100)}%</span>
        <span>x: {Math.round(pan.x)}, y: {Math.round(pan.y)}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { usePersianNumberInput } from '../hooks/usePersianNumberInput';

interface NumericFormatInputProps {
  value: number;
  onChange: (val: number) => void;
  className?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  id?: string;
}

export const NumericFormatInput: React.FC<NumericFormatInputProps> = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  className = '',
  placeholder = '',
  disabled = false,
  id
}) => {
  const {
    inputValue,
    inputRef,
    onChange: handleChange,
    onFocus: handleFocus,
    onBlur: handleBlur
  } = usePersianNumberInput({ value, onChange });

  return (
    <input
      ref={inputRef}
      id={id}
      type="text"
      inputMode="numeric"
      value={inputValue}
      onChange={handleChange}
      onFocus={handleFocus}
      onBlur={handleBlur}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`font-mono text-left dir-ltr ${className}`}
    />
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { AppView } from '../types';
import { useContent } from '../contexts/ContentContext';

// Advanced SEO Engine Meta Injector
export const SeoHead: React.FC<{ view: AppView }> = ({ view }) => {
  const { getSeoForView } = useContent();
  const config = getSeoForView(view);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Update Title
    document.title = config.title;

    // Helper to set meta tags
    const setMetaTag = (attr: 'name' | 'property', key: string, content: string) => {
      if (!content) return;
      let el = document.querySelector(`meta[${attr}="${key}"]`);
      if (!el) {
        el = document.createElement('meta');
        el.setAttribute(attr, key);
        document.head.appendChild(el);
      }
      el.setAttribute('content', content);
    };

    // 2. Standard Meta Tags
    setMetaTag('name', 'description', config.description);
    setMetaTag('name', 'keywords', config.keywords?.join(', '));
    setMetaTag('name', 'robots', 'index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1');
    setMetaTag('name', 'author', 'شرکت اشک قلم');

    // 3. OpenGraph Tags (Facebook, LinkedIn)
    setMetaTag('property', 'og:title', config.ogTitle || config.title);
    setMetaTag('property', 'og:description', config.ogDescription || config.description);
    setMetaTag('property', 'og:type', config.schemaType === 'Article' ? 'article' : 'website');
    if (config.ogImage) setMetaTag('property', 'og:image', config.ogImage);
    setMetaTag('property', 'og:locale', 'fa_IR');

    // 4. Twitter Cards
    setMetaTag('name', 'twitter:card', config.twitterCard || 'summary_large_image');
    setMetaTag('name', 'twitter:title', config.ogTitle || config.title);
    setMetaTag('name', 'twitter:description', config.ogDescription || config.description);
    if (config.ogImage) setMetaTag('name', 'twitter:image', config.ogImage);

    // 5. Canonical URL setup
    let canonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]');
    if (config.canonicalUrl) {
      if (!canonical) {
        canonical = document.createElement('link');
        canonical.setAttribute('rel', 'canonical');
        document.head.appendChild(canonical);
      }
      canonical.setAttribute('href', config.canonicalUrl);
    } else if (canonical) {
      canonical.remove(); // Safely remove if none is supplied
    }

    // 6. JSON-LD Structured Data Engine
    let schemaScript = document.querySelector('script[type="application/ld+json"]');
    // Generate intelligent default schemas based on schemaType if structuredData isn't provided manually
    let finalSchema = config.structuredData;
    if (!finalSchema) {
      if (config.schemaType === 'Organization') {
        finalSchema = {
          "@context": "https://schema.org",
          "@type": "Organization",
          "url": "https://ashkghalam.com",
          "name": "شرکت چاپ و بسته‌بندی اشک قلم",
          "contactPoint": {
            "@type": "ContactPoint",
            "telephone": "۰۲۱-۸۸۸۸۰۰۰۰",
            "contactType": "Customer Service"
          }
        };
      } else if (config.schemaType === 'WebSite') {
         finalSchema = {
           "@context": "https://schema.org",
           "@type": "WebSite",
           "url": "https://ashkghalam.com/",
           "potentialAction": {
             "@type": "SearchAction",
             "target": "https://ashkghalam.com/search?q={search_term_string}",
             "query-input": "required name=search_term_string"
           }
         };
      }
    }

    if (finalSchema) {
      if (!schemaScript) {
        schemaScript = document.createElement('script');
        schemaScript.setAttribute('type', 'application/ld+json');
        document.head.appendChild(schemaScript);
      }
      schemaScript.innerHTML = JSON.stringify(finalSchema);
    } else if (schemaScript) {
      schemaScript.remove(); // Keep head clean
    }

  }, [config]);

  // We could implement an on-screen SEO debug overlay here in Dev mode,
  // but we will build a dedicated SEO Dashboard instead.
  return null;
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  STANDARDS_METADATA, 
  validateStandardConstraints, 
  calculateTolerances, 
  calculateFoldLossCompensations, 
  evaluateGlueLapJoint,
  StandardRule
} from '../services/standardsEngine';
import { 
  Award, 
  Ruler, 
  Scale, 
  Info, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  ShieldAlert, 
  ChevronsUpDown, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Cpu, 
  Zap, 
  Compass, 
  Hammer,
  HelpCircle
} from 'lucide-react';

interface StandardsEnginePanelProps {
  dims: { L: number; W: number; H: number };
  selectedModelId: string;
  onModelChange?: (modelId: string) => void;
  material: { 
    id: string; 
    name: string; 
    category: 'SBS' | 'FBB' | 'Duplex' | 'Kraft' | 'Corrugated'; 
    thickness: number; 
    weight: number; 
    foldLoss: number;
  };
}

export const StandardsEnginePanel: React.FC<StandardsEnginePanelProps> = ({
  dims,
  selectedModelId,
  onModelChange,
  material
}) => {
  const [selectedStandardId, setSelectedStandardId] = useState<string>(selectedModelId);
  const [customGlueTab, setCustomGlueTab] = useState<number>(0);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'validation' | 'tolerance' | 'microgaps' | 'glueJoint'>('validation');

  // Sync selected Standard ID when parent model option changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedStandardId(selectedModelId);
  }, [selectedModelId]);

  // Lookup rule
  const activeRule = useMemo(() => {
    return STANDARDS_METADATA[selectedStandardId] || STANDARDS_METADATA['fefco-0201'];
  }, [selectedStandardId]);

  // Calculate live validations
  const liveValidation = useMemo(() => {
    return validateStandardConstraints(selectedStandardId, dims.L, dims.W, dims.H);
  }, [selectedStandardId, dims]);

  // Calculate manufacturing tolerances
  const tolerances = useMemo(() => {
    return calculateTolerances(
      selectedStandardId, 
      dims.L, 
      dims.W, 
      dims.H, 
      material.category
    );
  }, [selectedStandardId, dims, material]);

  // Calculate micro folding compensations
  const compressions = useMemo(() => {
    return calculateFoldLossCompensations(
      selectedStandardId, 
      material.thickness, 
      material.foldLoss
    );
  }, [selectedStandardId, material]);

  // Evaluate glue lap joints
  const glueLap = useMemo(() => {
    return evaluateGlueLapJoint(
      selectedStandardId, 
      dims.L, 
      dims.W, 
      dims.H, 
      material.thickness, 
      material.weight, 
      customGlueTab
    );
  }, [selectedStandardId, dims, material, customGlueTab]);

  const handleApplyStandardModel = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedStandardId(id);
    if (onModelChange) {
      onModelChange(id);
    }
  };

  const allStandards = Object.entries(STANDARDS_METADATA);

  return (
    <div id="standards-engine-dashboard" className="bg-[#0b0f19] text-slate-100 rounded-xl p-5 border border-slate-800 space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header Title Banner with Badge */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900/80 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-800 self-start">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping"></span>
          <span className="text-[9px] text-emerald-400 font-mono font-bold">CORE ONLINE</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-tr from-sky-650 to-sky-450 rounded-lg text-white shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/10 shrink-0">
            <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-100 tracking-tight leading-snug">موتور قوانین استانداردهای بین‌المللی FEFCO & ECMA</h2>
            <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">سامانه اعتبارسنجی هندسی ساختار و رواداری کاربری</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 mt-4">
        
        {/* TOP SECTION: Standards Registry / Selector */}
        <div className="bg-[#0d1424] rounded-lg p-3 border border-slate-850 flex flex-col max-h-[300px]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 pb-2 border-b border-slate-800 shrink-0">
            <Compass className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
            <h3 className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-200">الگوهای مرجع در دایرکتوری استاندارد</h3>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
            {allStandards.map(([id, item]) => {
              const isSelected = selectedStandardId === id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={id}
                  onClick={() => handleApplyStandardModel(id)}
                  className={`w-full text-right p-2.5 rounded-lg border transition-all flex items-center justify-between group ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-sky-950/40 border-sky-600 text-sky-300 shadow-sm' 
                      : 'bg-slate-900/40 border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-850/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="truncate max-w-[85%]">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${
                        item.category === 'FEFCO' 
                          ? 'bg-emerald-950/80 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-900/40' 
                          : 'bg-indigo-950/80 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-900/40'
                      }`}>
                        {item.code}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-100 truncate">{item.name}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 mt-1 truncate">{item.foldingRule}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${isSelected ? 'bg-sky-400 scale-125 shadow-md shadow-sky-400/50' : 'bg-transparent'}`}></div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-950 p-2.5 rounded mt-3 text-[9px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed border border-slate-850">

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* INTERACTIVE ACTIVE STANDARD ANALYTICS */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          
          {/* Info Card for selected Model */}

                <span className="text-xl">⚙️</span>

                </div>
              </div>
              <span className={`text-[10px] w-fit px-2 py-1 rounded border font-bold ${
                activeRule.category === 'FEFCO'

                  : 'bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-400 border-indigo-800/50'

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-center">
              <div className="bg-slate-950 rounded p-1.5 border border-slate-850">

                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-sky-400 mt-0.5 block">{activeRule.minL}-{activeRule.maxL} mm</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-950 rounded p-1.5 border border-slate-850">

                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-sky-400 mt-0.5 block">{activeRule.minW}-{activeRule.maxW} mm</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-950 rounded p-1.5 border border-slate-850">
                <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block font-mono">ارتفاع مجاز</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-sky-400 mt-0.5 block">{activeRule.minH}-{activeRule.maxH} mm</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-950 rounded p-1.5 border border-slate-850">
                <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block font-mono">نسبت کمانش</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-rose-400 mt-0.5 block">&lt; {activeRule.aspectRatioMaxH_to_W} (H/W)</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-850">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-400 font-bold mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px]">🛠️</span>
                  <span>مکانیزم خمش:</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-350 text-[10px] leading-relaxed font-sans">{activeRule.foldingRule}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-850">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-indigo-400 font-bold mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px]">💧</span>
                  <span>فرم چسب‌زنی:</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-350 text-[10px] leading-relaxed font-sans">{activeRule.glueRule}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tab Selection */}
          <div className="flex border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60 p-1 rounded-lg gap-1">
            {[
              { id: 'validation', label: 'تاییدیه هندسی سازه', icon: ShieldCheck },
              { id: 'tolerance', label: 'رواداری ابعادی (Tolerances)', icon: Ruler },
              { id: 'microgaps', label: 'جبران خط دور ریز (Compensations)', icon: Hammer },
              { id: 'glueJoint', label: 'تحلیلی کششی لبه چسب', icon: Scale }
            ].map(tab => {
              const IconComp = tab.icon;
              return (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}
                  className={`flex-1 py-2 px-1 text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold rounded-md flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                    activeTab === tab.id 
                      ? 'bg-slate-900 text-sky-400 border border-slate-850 shadow' 
                      : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <IconComp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline">{tab.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* TAB 1: GEOMETRIC VALIDATION REPORT */}
          {activeTab === 'validation' && (
            <div className="bg-[#0c1221] rounded-lg p-5 border border-slate-800 space-y-4">

                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-100">گزارش زنده تطابق با حد ابعاد استاندارد</h4>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">L={dims.L}mm | W={dims.W}mm | H={dims.H}mm</span>
              </div>

              {/* Status Indicator */}
              <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 border ${
                liveValidation.isValid 
                  ? 'bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-400' 
                  : 'bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-900/60 text-rose-400'
              }`}>
                {liveValidation.isValid ? (
                  <CheckCircle className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                ) : (
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-7 h-7 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />
                )}
                <div>
                  <h5 className="text-xs font-black">
                    {liveValidation.isValid 
                      ? 'سازه تایید شده است' 
                      : 'خطای انحراف ابعادی در سازه رخ داده است'
                    }
                  </h5>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    {liveValidation.isValid 
                      ? `ابعاد انتخابی در بازه توان فنی و ارگونومی قالب ${activeRule.code} است و احتمال پارگی یا اختلال فرآیند تاشو در سالن تولید صفر است.`
                      : `برخی ابعاد از توان هندسی شاسی یا قالب خارج است. انحراف از استاندارد سبب پارگی لبه چسب در زمان سرهم‌بندی خودکار خواهد شد.`
                    }
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Checklist details */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {/* L Checking */}

                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-500">محدوده: {activeRule.minL}mm - {activeRule.maxL}mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-1.5 bg-slate-950 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative">
                    <div 
                      className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${dims.L >= activeRule.minL && dims.L <= activeRule.maxL ? 'bg-sky-400' : 'bg-rose-500'}`}
                      style={{ 
                        marginLeft: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (activeRule.minL / activeRule.maxL) * 100))}%`,
                        width: `${Math.max(5, Math.min(100, ((dims.L) / activeRule.maxL) * 100))}%`
                      }}
                    ></div>
                    {/* Tick for current value */}
                    <div 
                      className="absolute top-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full border border-slate-100 bg-white shadow" 
                      style={{ left: `${Math.max(2, Math.min(98, (dims.L / activeRule.maxL) * 100))}%` }}
                    ></div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* W Checking */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] mb-1">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">عرض جعبه (W): <span className="font-mono text-slate-200">{dims.W}mm</span></span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-500">محدوده: {activeRule.minW}mm - {activeRule.maxW}mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-1.5 bg-slate-950 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative font-mono">
                    <div 
                      className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${dims.W >= activeRule.minW && dims.W <= activeRule.maxW ? 'bg-sky-400' : 'bg-rose-500'}`}
                      style={{ 
                        marginLeft: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (activeRule.minW / activeRule.maxW) * 100))}%`,
                        width: `${Math.max(5, Math.min(100, ((dims.W) / activeRule.maxW) * 100))}%`
                      }}
                    ></div>
                    <div 
                      className="absolute top-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full border border-slate-100 bg-white shadow" 
                      style={{ left: `${Math.max(2, Math.min(98, (dims.W / activeRule.maxW) * 100))}%` }}
                    ></div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* H Checking */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] mb-1">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">ارتفاع جعبه (H): <span className="font-mono text-slate-200">{dims.H}mm</span></span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-500">محدوده: {activeRule.minH}mm - {activeRule.maxH}mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-1.5 bg-slate-950 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative">
                    <div 
                      className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${dims.H >= activeRule.minH && dims.H <= activeRule.maxH ? 'bg-sky-400' : 'bg-rose-500'}`}
                      style={{ 
                        marginLeft: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (activeRule.minH / activeRule.maxH) * 100))}%`,
                        width: `${Math.max(5, Math.min(100, ((dims.H) / activeRule.maxH) * 100))}%`
                      }}
                    ></div>
                    <div 
                      className="absolute top-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full border border-slate-100 bg-white shadow" 
                      style={{ left: `${Math.max(2, Math.min(98, (dims.H / activeRule.maxH) * 100))}%` }}
                    ></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Live Alerts list (warnings or errors) */}
              {(liveValidation.errors.length > 0 || liveValidation.warnings.length > 0) && (
                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-2.5 text-[10.5px]">
                  {liveValidation.errors.map((err, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex gap-2 text-rose-450 bg-rose-955/20 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-rose-900/35">
                      <span className="shrink-0">⚠️</span>
                      <p>{err}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {liveValidation.warnings.map((warn, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex gap-2 text-amber-450 bg-amber-955/10 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-amber-900/30">
                      <span className="shrink-0">💡</span>
                      <p>{warn}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: MANUFACTURING TOLERANCES */}
          {activeTab === 'tolerance' && (
            <div className="bg-[#0c1221] rounded-lg p-5 border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
                <Ruler className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-100">برآورد رواداری‌های خط تولید کارگاهی (Technical tolerances)</h4>
              </div>

              <p className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans">{tolerances.explanation}</p>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
                <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-850 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">رواداری گونیا بودن لولاها (Diagonal)</span>
                    <span className="text-base font-black font-mono text-teal-400 mt-1 block">±{tolerances.diagonalSquarenessTolerance} mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xl bg-teal-950/60 p-2 rounded text-teal-400 border border-teal-900/30">📐</span>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-850 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">تلورانس ابعاد کلی (L, W, H)</span>
                    <span className="text-base font-black font-mono text-sky-400 mt-1 block">±{tolerances.lengthTolerance} mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xl bg-sky-950/60 p-2 rounded text-sky-400 border border-sky-900/30">📏</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-850 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-slate-400">
                ⚠️ <strong className="text-slate-300">توجه کارگاهی:</strong> هرگاه در ماشین پانچ قالب، فرسودگی پانچ رخ دهد انحراف گونیا افزایش می‌یابد. در صورت تغییر جنس به کارتن کنگره‌دار، حتماً تلورانس گستردگی ابعاد را حداقل ±1 میلی‌متر در خط جک بسته‌بندی رعایت فرمایید.
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: MICRO COMPENSATIONS */}
          {activeTab === 'microgaps' && (
            <div className="bg-[#0c1221] rounded-lg p-5 border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
                <Hammer className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-100">تعدیل خم مقوا و کسر خط‌تا (Micro Panel Compensations)</h4>
              </div>

              <p className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans">{compressions.explanation}</p>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-2">
                <div className="bg-slate-900/50 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-850 text-center">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block">پاشنه شیار لولا (Joint Gap)</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1 block font-mono">+{compressions.jointGap} mm</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-900/50 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-850 text-center">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block">کوتاه‌سازی درپوش داخلی</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1 block font-mono">-{compressions.innerFlapShortening} mm</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-900/50 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-850 text-center">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block">پخ لبه چسبانک</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1 block font-mono">-{compressions.glueFlapReduction} mm</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-900/50 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-850 text-center">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 block">ترخیص گردگیر بغل</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200 mt-1 block font-mono">-{compressions.dustFlapClearance} mm</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-slate-400 border border-slate-850">
                ✔️ <strong className="text-slate-350">فرمول خودکار:</strong> این مقادیر تعدیل برای رفع برخورد فیزیکی لولاها هنگام زاویه‌گیری ۹۰ یا ۱۸۰ درجه محاسبه شده‌اند و جهت اعمال در نقشه و ترسیمه قالب دوبعدی دایکات بر رانت نهایی اعمال می‌شوند.
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 4: ADHESIVE STRENGTH SIMULATION */}
          {activeTab === 'glueJoint' && (
            <div className="bg-[#0c1221] rounded-lg p-5 border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Scale className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-100">شبیه‌سازی گشتاور و نیروی الیاف لبه چسب</h4>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">استاندارد لبه: {activeRule.defGlueTab}mm</span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                
                {/* Inputs & Status Display */}
                <div className="space-y-3.5">
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1">عرض زبانه چسب مورد نظر (میلی‌متر) [۰ جهت استفاده از پیش‌فرض]:</label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <input 
                        type="text"
                        inputMode="decimal"
                        value={customGlueTab || ''}
                        onChange={e => {
                          const englishVal = e.target.value.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d).toString()).replace(/[٠-٩]/g, d => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d).toString());
                          setCustomGlueTab(Number(englishVal));
                        }}
                        placeholder={`${activeRule.defGlueTab} mm`}
                        className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white outline-none w-28 focus:border-sky-500 font-mono"
                      />
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => setCustomGlueTab(0)}
                        className="text-[9px] bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 px-2 py-1 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                      >
                        بازنشانی پیش‌فرض
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Status Indicator Bar */}
                  <div className={`p-3.5 rounded border flex items-center gap-2.5 ${
                    glueLap.isSafe 
                      ? 'bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-400' 
                      : 'bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-900/50 text-rose-400'
                  }`}>
                    <span className="text-base">{glueLap.isSafe ? '🛡️' : '🚨'}</span>
                    <div>
                      <h5 className="text-[10.5px] font-black">
                        {glueLap.isSafe ? 'مقاومت غلتکی لبه ایمن است' : 'ریسک جداشدگی شدید لبه چسب!'}
                      </h5>
                      <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono text-slate-450 uppercase block mt-0.5">
                        Safety Factor: {glueLap.passSafetyFactor === 999 ? 'MAX' : `${glueLap.passSafetyFactor}x`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Quantitative Data Panel */}
                <div className="bg-slate-950 rounded-lg p-3.5 border border-slate-850 space-y-2">
                  <h5 className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-300">تحلیل بارهای فیزیکی اتصال مونو:</h5>
                  
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-450 border-b border-slate-900 py-1">
                    <span>مساحت مفید آغشته به چسب:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-200">{glueLap.lapAreaSqMm} mm²</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-455 border-b border-slate-900 py-1">
                    <span>سفتی ساختاری ورق (Stiffness approx):</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-200">{glueLap.stiffnessIndexPct}%</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-455 border-b border-slate-900 py-1">
                    <span>نیروی ارتجاعی الیاف (Springback force):</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-amber-400 font-bold">{glueLap.springbackForceN} N</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-455 py-1">
                    <span>مقاومت برشی نهایی چسب (Shear resistance):</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold">{glueLap.shearStrengthN} N</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>

              {/* Warnings List if any */}
              {glueLap.warnings.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-[10px]">
                  {glueLap.warnings.map((warn, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="flex gap-2 text-rose-350 bg-rose-955/10 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded">
                      <span>•</span>
                      <p>{warn}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useContent } from '../contexts/ContentContext';
import { 
  UserCheck, Shield, Key, UserPlus, Trash, Edit, CheckSquare, Square, 
  Lock, Phone, Mail, User, Briefcase, Calendar, FolderLock, Sparkles, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, Button, Badge } from './UIComponents';
import { 
  getAllUsersExcludingPassword, createTeamAccount, updateAccount, deleteAccount, UserPermissions 
} from '../services/authService';
import { UserRole } from '../types';

const renderAvatarOffline = (url: string | null, name: string, sizeClass = "w-10 h-10 text-xs") => {
  const initial = name ? name[0] : '?';
  const colors = [
    'bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold',
    'bg-teal-600 text-white font-bold',
    'bg-violet-600 text-white font-bold',
    'bg-sky-600 text-white font-bold',
    'bg-amber-600 text-white font-bold',
    'bg-purple-600 text-white font-bold',
    'bg-rose-600 text-white font-bold'
  ];
  const charCodeSum = name ? [...name].reduce((acc, char) => acc + char.charCodeAt(0), 0) : 0;
  const bgClass = colors[charCodeSum % colors.length];

  if (!url || url.includes('pravatar.cc')) {
    return (
      <div className={`${sizeClass} rounded-full flex items-center justify-center uppercase shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 ${bgClass}`}>
        {initial}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <img 
      src={url} 
      alt={name} 
      className={`${sizeClass} rounded-full object-cover border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700`}
      onError={(e) => {
        e.currentTarget.style.display = 'none';
        const parent = e.currentTarget.parentNode;
        if (parent) {
          const fallback = document.createElement('div');
          fallback.className = `${sizeClass} rounded-full flex items-center justify-center uppercase border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 ${bgClass}`;
          fallback.innerText = initial;
          parent.appendChild(fallback);
        }
      }}
    />
  );
};

export const TeamManagementPanel: React.FC<{ isDarkMode?: boolean }> = ({ isDarkMode = false }) => {
  const { user: currentUser } = useAuth();
  const { uploadAsset } = useContent();

  const [users, setUsers] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // My Profile Edit State
  const [profileName, setProfileName] = useState('');
  const [profilePhone, setProfilePhone] = useState('');
  const [profileEmail, setProfileEmail] = useState('');
  const [profileAvatar, setProfileAvatar] = useState('');
  const [profilePassword, setProfilePassword] = useState('');

  // New Account State

  const [newAccUsername, setNewAccUsername] = useState('');
  const [newAccPassword, setNewAccPassword] = useState('');
  const [newAccPhone, setNewAccPhone] = useState('');
  const [newAccEmail, setNewAccEmail] = useState('');
  const [newAccRole, setNewAccRole] = useState<UserRole>(UserRole.SMB);
  const [newAccPermissions, setNewAccPermissions] = useState<UserPermissions>({
    crmDashboard: true,
    treasuryAndLedger: false,
    inquiryRateSettings: false,
    cmsContentEditing: false,
    backupSystem: false,
  });

  // Editing existing account state
  const [editingUserId, setEditingUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editAccName, setEditAccName] = useState('');
  const [editAccPassword, setEditAccPassword] = useState('');
  const [editAccPhone, setEditAccPhone] = useState('');
  const [editAccEmail, setEditAccEmail] = useState('');
  const [editAccRole, setEditAccRole] = useState<UserRole>(UserRole.SMB);
  const [editAccPermissions, setEditAccPermissions] = useState<UserPermissions>({
    crmDashboard: true,
    treasuryAndLedger: false,
    inquiryRateSettings: false,
    cmsContentEditing: false,
    backupSystem: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {

      setProfileName(currentUser.name || '');

      setProfileAvatar(currentUser.avatar || '');

  }, [currentUser]);
```
