import React from 'react';
import * as Icons from 'lucide-react';

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({ 
  children, 
  variant = 'primary', 
  size = 'md', 
  isLoading, 
  className = '', 
  ...props 
}) => {
  const baseStyles = "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed";
  
  const variants = {
    primary: "bg-primary-600 text-white hover:bg-primary-700 focus:ring-primary-500",
    secondary: "bg-secondary-500 text-white hover:bg-secondary-600 focus:ring-secondary-500",
    outline: "border-2 border-primary-600 text-primary-600 hover:bg-primary-50 focus:ring-primary-500",
    ghost: "text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-800",
  };

  const sizes = {
    sm: "px-3 py-1.5 text-sm",
    md: "px-4 py-2 text-base",
    lg: "px-6 py-3 text-lg",
  };

  return (
    <button 
      className={`${baseStyles} ${variants[variant]} ${sizes[size]} ${className}`}
      disabled={isLoading || props.disabled}
      {...props}
    >
      {isLoading ? (
        <svg className="animate-spin -ml-1 mr-3 h-5 w-5 text-current" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <circle className="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="4"></circle>
          <path className="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
        </svg>
      ) : null}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};

import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

interface CardProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  icon?: React.ElementType;
  iconName?: string;
  iconColor?: 'blue' | 'green' | 'purple' | 'orange' | 'red' | 'gray';
  title?: string;
}

export const Card: React.FC<CardProps> = ({ children, className = '', icon, iconName, iconColor = 'blue', title }) => {
  const colors = {
    blue: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300',
    green: 'bg-green-100 text-green-600 dark:bg-green-900/40 dark:text-green-300',
    purple: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-600 dark:bg-purple-900/40 dark:text-purple-300',
    orange: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 dark:bg-orange-900/40 dark:text-orange-300',
    red: 'bg-red-100 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-900/40 dark:text-red-300',
    gray: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300',
  };

  // Resolve Icon from Name or Prop
  let IconToRender = icon;
  if (!IconToRender && iconName) {
    // @ts-ignore
    IconToRender = Icons[iconName] || Icons.HelpCircle; 
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      whileHover={{ scale: 1.02, boxShadow: '0px 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0px 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)' }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
      className={`bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden ${className}`}
    >
      {(title || IconToRender) && (
        <div className="p-6 pb-0 flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
          {IconToRender && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${colors[iconColor]} transition-colors`}>
              {/* @ts-ignore */}
              <IconToRender className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
          )}
          {title && <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{title}</h3>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={title || IconToRender ? 'px-6 pb-6' : ''}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export const Badge: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; color?: string; className?: string }> = ({ children, color = 'blue', className = '' }) => {
  const colorClass = color === 'gold' 
    ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-300' 
    : color === 'green'
    ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300'
    : color === 'red'
    ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300'
    : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300';
    
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${colorClass} ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';

interface WebGLPageFlipProps {
  frontPageUrl: string;
  backPageUrl: string;
  isDragging: boolean;
  dragProgress: number;
  direction: 'next' | 'prev';
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isDarkMode?: boolean;
}

// Global GPU texture cache to keep decoded Three.js textures in memory
const glTextureCache = new Map<string, THREE.Texture>();

export const WebGLPageFlip: React.FC<WebGLPageFlipProps> = ({
  frontPageUrl,
  backPageUrl,
  isDragging,
  dragProgress,
  direction,
  width,
  height,
  isDarkMode = false
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Store transition state so we can smoothly animate on requestAnimationFrame
  const progressRef = useRef(0);
  const velocityRef = useRef(0);
  const targetProgressRef = useRef(0);

  const isDraggingRef = useRef(isDragging);
  const directionRef = useRef(direction);
  const isDarkModeRef = useRef(isDarkMode);
  const materialRef = useRef<THREE.ShaderMaterial | null>(null);

  // Keep references to values fresh so animation loop doesn't restart
  useEffect(() => {
    targetProgressRef.current = dragProgress;
  }, [dragProgress]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isDraggingRef.current = isDragging;
  }, [isDragging]);

  useEffect(() => {
    directionRef.current = direction;
  }, [direction]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isDarkModeRef.current = isDarkMode;
  }, [isDarkMode]);

  // Handle Texture Loading and dynamic uniform mapping
  const loadTextureCustom = (url: string, isFront: boolean, material: THREE.ShaderMaterial) => {
    if (!url) return;

    // Check GPU cache first for instantaneous texture assignment
    if (glTextureCache.has(url)) {
      const cachedTex = glTextureCache.get(url)!;
      if (isFront) {
        material.uniforms.mapFront.value = cachedTex;
        setIsLoaded(true);
      } else {
        material.uniforms.mapBack.value = cachedTex;
      }
      material.needsUpdate = true;
      return;
    }

    const img = new Image();
    if (!url.startsWith('blob:')) {
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    }

    img.onload = () => {
      const tex = new THREE.Texture(img);
      tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
      tex.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
      tex.generateMipmaps = true;
      tex.needsUpdate = true;

      // Add to global GPU cache
      glTextureCache.set(url, tex);

      if (isFront) {
        material.uniforms.mapFront.value = tex;
        setIsLoaded(true);
      } else {
        material.uniforms.mapBack.value = tex;
      }
      material.needsUpdate = true;
    };

    img.onerror = (err) => {
      console.warn(`Failed to load ${isFront ? 'front' : 'back'} page image in WebGL custom loader`, err);
    };

    img.src = url;
  };

  // Dedicated useEffect to load textures when URLs change (No rebuild of Three.js context)
  useEffect(() => {
    const material = materialRef.current;
    if (material && frontPageUrl) {
      loadTextureCustom(frontPageUrl, true, material);
    }
  }, [frontPageUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const material = materialRef.current;
    if (material && backPageUrl) {
      loadTextureCustom(backPageUrl, false, material);
    }
  }, [backPageUrl]);

  // Main canvas context setup - Only runs on physical container dimension changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current || !width || !height) return;

    const container = containerRef.current;
    const pageW = width / 2;
    const pageH = height;

    // 1. Create Scene & Camera
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    const camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(
      -width / 2, width / 2,
      height / 2, -height / 2,
      0.1, 2000
    );
    camera.position.z = 1000;

    // 2. Create WebGL Renderer
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      alpha: true,
      premultipliedAlpha: false
    });
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(width, height);
    renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); // transparent background
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Initial placeholder textures (blank white)
    const createPlaceholderTexture = () => {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 128;
      canvas.height = 128;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (ctx) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#faf9f6';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
      }
      return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
    };

    let frontTex = createPlaceholderTexture();
    let backTex = createPlaceholderTexture();
    frontTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    backTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

    // Custom Vertex Shader for precise inextensible page curl physics deformation
    const vertexShader = `
      uniform float progress;
      uniform float direction; // 1.0 for next (R to L), -1.0 for prev (L to R)
      uniform float pageWidth;
      uniform float pageHeight;

      varying vec2 vUv;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vViewPosition;

      void main() {
        vUv = uv;

        float x_loc = uv.x;
        float y_loc = uv.y - 0.5; // [-0.5, 0.5]

        float pi = 3.14159265359;

        // Crease location sweeps from right to left
        float foldCenter = 1.08 - progress * 1.16;

        // Subtle diagonal bending slant to peel corners first
        float diagonalTilt = 0.12 * y_loc * sin(progress * pi);
        foldCenter += diagonalTilt;

        // Curvature width reaches maximum at progress = 0.5
        float W = 0.04 + 0.22 * sin(progress * pi);

        float steps = 24.0;
        float ds = x_loc / steps;

        float currentX = 0.0;
        float currentZ = 0.0;
        float finalTheta = 0.0;

        for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
          float s = (float(i) + 0.5) * ds;
          
          float theta = 0.0;
          if (s > foldCenter) {
            if (s < foldCenter + W) {
              float t = (s - foldCenter) / W;
              theta = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, t) * pi;
            } else {
              theta = pi;
            }
          }

          currentX += cos(theta) * ds;
          currentZ += sin(theta) * ds;
          
          if (i == 23) {
            finalTheta = theta;
          }
        }

        vec3 localPos = vec3(currentX, y_loc, currentZ);
        vec3 normalLocal = vec3(-sin(finalTheta), 0.0, cos(finalTheta));

        // Apply page-turn direction multiplier
        float sideSign = direction > 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
        localPos.x *= sideSign;
        normalLocal.x *= sideSign;

        vec3 physicalPos;
        physicalPos.x = localPos.x * pageWidth;
        physicalPos.y = localPos.y * pageHeight;
        physicalPos.z = localPos.z * pageWidth * 0.75; // subtle lifting elevation

        vec4 mvPosition = modelViewMatrix * vec4(physicalPos, 1.0);
        vViewPosition = -mvPosition.xyz;
        vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normalLocal);

        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
      }
    `;

    // Custom Fragment Shader for ultra-subtle photo-realistic lighting and shadow blending
    const fragmentShader = `
      uniform sampler2D mapFront;
      uniform sampler2D mapBack;
      uniform float isDarkMode;
      uniform float progress;

      varying vec2 vUv;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vViewPosition;

      void main() {
        vec4 texColor;
        vec3 normal = normalize(vNormal);

        // Determine facing side of the page using transformed face normal in view space

        bool isFront = normal.z >= 0.0;

          vec2 backUv = vec2(1.0 - vUv.x, vUv.y);

        // Blending texture with a solid ivory/white premium paper background to prevent any texture transparency
        vec3 paperColor = mix(vec3(0.98, 0.97, 0.95), texColor.rgb, texColor.a);

        // To comply with the rule of premium paper/cardboard material, pages must NOT display transparency 
        // or look muddy and dark during page turning. We provide extremely bright uniform lighting.
        float centerFactor = sin(progress * 3.14159265);
        
        // Very soft page-bend curve shadow (max 4% occlusion to represent subtle three-dimensional paper depth)
        float creaseOcclusion = 1.0 - 0.04 * centerFactor;
        vec3 finalLight = vec3(creaseOcclusion);

        gl_FragColor = vec4(paperColor * finalLight, 1.0);
      }
    `;

    const customMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: {
        mapFront: { value: frontTex },
        mapBack: { value: backTex },
        progress: { value: 0.0 },
        direction: { value: direction === 'next' ? 1.0 : -1.0 },
        pageWidth: { value: pageW },
        pageHeight: { value: pageH },
        isDarkMode: { value: isDarkMode ? 1.0 : 0.0 }
      },
      vertexShader,
      fragmentShader,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      transparent: false
    });

    materialRef.current = customMaterial;

    // Load actual textures if available upon initialization
    if (frontPageUrl) {
      loadTextureCustom(frontPageUrl, true, customMaterial);
    }
    if (backPageUrl) {
      loadTextureCustom(backPageUrl, false, customMaterial);
    }

    const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 80, 80);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, customMaterial);
    scene.add(mesh);

    let animationFrameId: number;
    let lastTime = performance.now();

    const animate = () => {
      animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      const now = performance.now();
      let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
      lastTime = now;
      if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;

      // Update uniforms that can change mid-motion
      customMaterial.uniforms.direction.value = directionRef.current === 'next' ? 1.0 : -1.0;
      customMaterial.uniforms.isDarkMode.value = isDarkModeRef.current ? 1.0 : 0.0;

      const stiffness = isDraggingRef.current ? 320.0 : 120.0;
      const damping = isDraggingRef.current ? 35.0 : 12.0;
      const mass = 1.0;

      const error = progressRef.current - targetProgressRef.current;
      const springForce = -stiffness * error;
      const dampingForce = -damping * velocityRef.current;
      const acceleration = (springForce + dampingForce) / mass;

      velocityRef.current += acceleration * dt;
      progressRef.current += velocityRef.current * dt;

      const progressValue = Math.min(Math.max(progressRef.current, 0.0), 1.0);
      customMaterial.uniforms.progress.value = progressValue;

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    };

    animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
      if (container.contains(renderer.domElement)) {
        container.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
      }
      geometry.dispose();
      customMaterial.dispose();
      frontTex.dispose();
      backTex.dispose();
      renderer.dispose();
      materialRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [width, height]); // Recreate ONLY when chassis dimensions change!

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef} 
      id="webgl-page-flip-stage"
      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-30 transition-opacity duration-300 transform-gpu"
      style={{ width: `${width}px`, height: `${height}px` }}
    />
  );
};

const getUsers = (): any[] => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('users_db') || '[]');
  }
  return [];
};

const saveUsers = (users: any[]) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    localStorage.setItem('users_db', JSON.stringify(users));
  }
};

export const loginUser = async (username: string, password: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; user?: User; error?: string }> => {
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800));

  const users = getUsers();
  const user = users.find(u => u.username === username && u.password === password);

  if (user) {
    const { password, ...userWithoutPassword } = user;
    return { success: true, user: userWithoutPassword as User };
  }

  return { success: false, error: 'نام کاربری یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.' };
};

export const registerUser = async (data: any): Promise<{ success: boolean; user?: User; error?: string }> => {
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800));
  
  const users = getUsers();
  if (users.some(u => u.username === data.username)) {
    return { success: false, error: 'این نام کاربری قبلا ثبت شده است.' };
  }

  const newUser = {
    id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
    name: data.name,
    username: data.username,
    password: data.password,
    role: UserRole.SMB,
    tokens: 50,
    companyName: data.companyName,
    joinDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR'),
    avatar: data.avatar || `https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=${data.username}`,
    permissions: data.permissions || {
      crmDashboard: true,
      treasuryAndLedger: true,
      inquiryRateSettings: true,
      cmsContentEditing: true,
      backupSystem: true
    }
  };
  
  users.push(newUser);
  saveUsers(users);

  const { password, ...userWithoutPassword } = newUser;
  return { success: true, user: userWithoutPassword as User };
};

export const loginGuest = async (): Promise<User> => {
  return {
    id: `guest-${Date.now()}`,
    name: 'کاربر مهمان',
    username: 'guest',
    role: UserRole.GUEST,
    tokens: 0,
    companyName: '---'
  };
};

// --- Advanced Team Accounts & Profile Services ---

export interface UserPermissions {
  crmDashboard: boolean;
  treasuryAndLedger: boolean;
  inquiryRateSettings: boolean;
  cmsContentEditing: boolean;
  backupSystem: boolean;
}

export const getAllUsersExcludingPassword = (): any[] => {
  return getUsers();
};

export const createTeamAccount = async (accountData: {
  name: string;
  username: string;
  password?: string;
  role: UserRole;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  companyName?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  permissions: UserPermissions;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
  const users = getUsers();
  if (users.some(u => u.username.toLowerCase() === accountData.username.toLowerCase())) {
    return { success: false, error: 'این نام کاربری از پیش رزرو شده است.' };
  }

  const newAcc = {
    id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
    ...accountData,
    password: accountData.password || '123456',
    tokens: accountData.role === UserRole.ADMIN ? 9999 : 200,
    joinDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')
  };

  users.push(newAcc);
  saveUsers(users);
  return { success: true };
};

export const updateAccount = async (
  userId: string,
  updatedFields: Partial<any>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
  const users = getUsers();
  const index = users.findIndex(u => u.id === userId);
  if (index === -1) {
    return { success: false, error: 'حساب یافت نشد.' };
  }

  // Update
  users[index] = { ...users[index], ...updatedFields };
  saveUsers(users);

  // Sync with current session if we are modifying the logged-in user
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const active = localStorage.getItem('ashk_user');
    if (active) {
      const activeObj = JSON.parse(active);
      if (activeObj.id === userId) {
        const { password, ...withoutPassword } = users[index];
        localStorage.setItem('ashk_user', JSON.stringify(withoutPassword));
      }
    }
  }

  return { success: true };
};

export const deleteAccount = async (userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> => {
  const users = getUsers();
  const active = localStorage.getItem('ashk_user');
  if (active) {
    const activeObj = JSON.parse(active);
    if (activeObj.id === userId) {
      return { success: false, error: 'شما نمی‌توانید حساب جاری خودتان را حذف نمایید.' };
    }
  }

  const filtered = users.filter(u => u.id !== userId);
  saveUsers(filtered);
  return { success: true };
};

// =========================================================================
// STANDARD PARAMETRIC DIELINE GEOMETRY ENGINE (FEFCO & ECMA SPECS)
// CHAPE ASHK GHALAM PROFESSIONAL CAD ENGINE - ARTIOSCAD COMPLIANT METRICS
// =========================================================================
// This module implements precise, industry-grade dieline geometry drawing.
// To ensure direct compatibility with CNC laser die-cutters and folder-gluers,
// ALL curved approximations (cubic and quadratic Beziers) have been replaced
// with high-fidelity, CAD-compliant straight polylines (using precise angles,
// 45° and 15° chamfers, undercut notches, and exact laser clearances).
// Circular arcs are drawn with native SVG 'A' commands representing exact circular
// drill patterns (G02/G03), completely preventing cutting-head noise and vibrations.

export interface DielineGeometryResult {
  cuts: string[];
  creases: string[];
  labels: { x: number; y: number; text: string; rotate?: number; color?: string }[];
  totalW: number;
  totalH: number;
  xMin: number;
  yMin: number;
  xMax: number;
  yMax: number;
}

export interface DielineParams {
  L: number;
  W: number;
  H: number;
  glueTab: number;
  tuck: number;
  dustFlap: number;
  x0: number;
  variant?: string;
}

export type DielineEngine = (params: DielineParams) => DielineGeometryResult;

// Rounding / snapping helper to ensure precision on a 0.01 mm grid
function snap(val: number): number {
  return Math.round(val * 100) / 100;
}

export function calculateDielineParameters(
  L: number,
  W: number,
  H: number,
  thickness: number,
  modelId: string
): {
  glueTab: number;
  tuck: number;
  dustFlap: number;
  isSmallBoxActive: boolean;
} {
  // 1. Initial baseline calculations
  let glueTab = 14; 
  let tuck = 15;
  let dustFlap = W * 0.35; 

  if (modelId === 'ecma-a2020') {
    // Rule #4: ECMA A20.20 tuck flap height and dust flap specs
    const recTuck = W * 0.28; 
    tuck = Math.min(25, Math.max(12, recTuck)); 

    const recDust = W * 0.35; 
    dustFlap = Math.min(W * 0.45, Math.max(W * 0.25, recDust));
  } else if (modelId === 'snap-lock-123') {
    const recTuck = W * 0.3;
    tuck = Math.min(30, Math.max(12, recTuck));
    dustFlap = Math.min(W * 0.45, Math.max(W * 0.25, W * 0.35));
  } else if (modelId === 'fefco-0215') {
    tuck = Math.min(25, Math.max(12, W * 0.3));
    dustFlap = Math.min(W * 0.45, Math.max(W * 0.25, W * 0.35));
    glueTab = Math.min(30, Math.max(15, H * 0.15));
  } else if (modelId === 'fefco-0427' || modelId === 'fefco-pizza') { 
    tuck = Math.min(35, Math.max(15, H * 0.7)); 
    dustFlap = W * 0.4;
    glueTab = 0; 
  } else {
    tuck = Math.min(30, Math.max(12, W * 0.3));
    dustFlap = Math.min(W * 0.45, Math.max(W * 0.25, W * 0.35));
    glueTab = Math.min(30, Math.max(15, H * 0.15));
  }

  // 2. Rule #6: Glue flap standardization limits
  if (modelId === 'ecma-a2020') {
    glueTab = Math.min(15, Math.max(10, glueTab)); 
  }
  
  if (glueTab > 0) {
    glueTab = Math.max(6, Math.min(glueTab, W * 0.3));
  }

  if (glueTab > 0 && modelId !== 'ecma-a2020') {
    glueTab = Math.max(glueTab, 15 + thickness * 0.5);
    glueTab = Math.min(glueTab, W * 0.3);
  }

  // 3. Rule #5: Small box protection mode (L < 80 or W < 40 or H < 20)
  const isSmallBoxActive = L < 80 || W < 40 || H < 20;
  if (isSmallBoxActive) {
    const scaleFactor = Math.max(0.4, Math.min(
      L < 80 ? L / 80 : 1,
      W < 40 ? W / 40 : 1,
      H < 20 ? H / 20 : 1
    ));
    
    tuck = tuck * scaleFactor;
    dustFlap = dustFlap * scaleFactor;
    if (glueTab > 0) {
      glueTab = glueTab * scaleFactor;
    }
  }

  return {
    glueTab: snap(glueTab),
    tuck: snap(tuck),
    dustFlap: snap(dustFlap),
    isSmallBoxActive
  };
}

export const STANDARD_DIELINE_ENGINES: Record<string, DielineEngine> = {
  // --- ECMA A20.20: PHARMACEUTICAL LOCK-END TUCK BOX (دارویی داربستی) ---
  'ecma-a2020': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + W;
    const x3 = x2 + L;
    const x4 = x3 + W;
    const x5 = x4 + L;

    const yMid = 180;
    const yTop = yMid - W;
    const yBot = yMid + H + W;

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yMid - (W + tuck + 15);
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yMid + H + (W + tuck + 15);

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Horizontal creases (Scores)
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    
    // Vertical creases separating panels
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));
    
    // Flap fold score lines
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yTop} L ${x3},${yTop}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x4},${yBot} L ${x5},${yBot}`);

    // --- ARTIOSEC-STANDARD CUT PATHS (BEAUTIFULLY FILLETED SMOOTH RADII) ---
    
    // Glue Tab Left: 45-degree chamfers to prevent overflow in automatic folder-gluers
    const gtTapTop = 5;
    const gtTapBot = 8;
    const rT = 3;
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x1},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop} ` +
      `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop + rT} ` +
      `L ${x0 + 2},${yMid + H - gtTapBot - rT} ` +
      `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + H - gtTapBot} ` +
      `L ${x1},${yMid + H}`
    );

    // Common Tuck Flap logic that prevents overlapping strokes
    const drawTuckFlap = (startX: number, endX: number, foldY: number, tH: number, isTop: boolean) => {
      const taperX = 5;
      const sign = isTop ? -1 : 1;
      const yTip = foldY + sign * tH;
      return `M ${startX},${foldY} ` +
             `L ${startX + taperX},${yTip} ` +
             `L ${endX - taperX},${yTip} ` +
             `L ${endX},${foldY}`;
    };

    // Vertical lid sides - top lid (Panel 2)
    cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yTop}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yTop}`);
    // Top Lid Tuck
    cuts.push(drawTuckFlap(x2, x3, yTop, tuck, true));

    // Vertical lid sides - bottom lid (Panel 4)
    cuts.push(`M ${x4},${yMid + H} L ${x4},${yBot}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yBot}`);
    // Bottom Lid Tuck
    cuts.push(drawTuckFlap(x4, x5, yBot, tuck, false));

    // Dust Flaps with professional clear gaps
    const drawDustFlap = (staX: number, endX: number, foldY: number, hasTaper: boolean, dH: number, isTop: boolean) => {
      const taperX = dH * 0.268; // 15 degrees
      const gap = 1.5;
      const sign = isTop ? -1 : 1;
      const dy = foldY + sign * dH;
      return `M ${staX},${foldY} ` +
             `L ${staX + gap},${foldY + sign * gap} ` +
             `L ${staX + gap + taperX},${dy} ` +
             `L ${endX - gap - taperX},${dy} ` +
             `L ${endX - gap},${foldY + sign * gap} ` +
             `L ${endX},${foldY}`;
    };

    // Top Dust flaps on Panel 1 and 3
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x1, x2, yMid, true, dustFlap, true));
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x3, x4, yMid, true, dustFlap, true));
    
    // Bottom Dust flaps on Panel 1 and 3
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x1, x2, yMid + H, true, dustFlap, false));
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x3, x4, yMid + H, true, dustFlap, false));

    // Outer right boundary edge
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    // Labels
    labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W: ${Math.round(W)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L: ${Math.round(L)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x3+x4)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W: ${Math.round(W)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x4+x5)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L: ${Math.round(L)}` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- ECMA A30: PEG HANGER SLOT RETAIL BOX (آویز دار پگ‌بورد) ---
  'ecma-a30': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + W;
    const x3 = x2 + L;
    const x4 = x3 + W;
    const x5 = x4 + L;

    const yMid = 180;
    const headerH = Math.max(35, W + 15); 

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yMid - (W + headerH + 15);
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yMid + H + (W + tuck + 15);

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Crease lines
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid - W} L ${x3},${yMid - W}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x4},${yMid + H + W} L ${x5},${yMid + H + W}`);

    // Glue Tab Left
    const gtTapTop = 5;
    const gtTapBot = 8;
    const rT = 3;
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x1},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop} ` +
      `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop + rT} ` +
      `L ${x0 + 2},${yMid + H - gtTapBot - rT} ` +
      `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + H - gtTapBot} ` +
      `L ${x1},${yMid + H}`
    );

    const drawTuckFlap = (startX: number, endX: number, foldY: number, tH: number, isTop: boolean) => {
      const taperX = 5;
      const sign = isTop ? -1 : 1;
      const yTip = foldY + sign * tH;
      return `M ${startX},${foldY} ` +
             `L ${startX + taperX},${yTip} ` +
             `L ${endX - taperX},${yTip} ` +
             `L ${endX},${foldY}`;
    };

    // Top Tuck Lid 
    cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yMid - W}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid - W}`);
    cuts.push(drawTuckFlap(x2, x3, yMid - W, tuck, true));

    const drawDustFlap = (staX: number, endX: number, foldY: number, hasTaper: boolean, dH: number, isTop: boolean) => {
      const taperX = dH * 0.268; // 15 degrees
      const gap = 1.5;
      const sign = isTop ? -1 : 1;
      const dy = foldY + sign * dH;
      return `M ${staX},${foldY} ` +
             `L ${staX + gap},${foldY + sign * gap} ` +
             `L ${staX + gap + taperX},${dy} ` +
             `L ${endX - gap - taperX},${dy} ` +
             `L ${endX - gap},${foldY + sign * gap} ` +
             `L ${endX},${foldY}`;
    };

    // Dust flaps
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x1, x2, yMid, true, dustFlap, true));
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x3, x4, yMid, true, dustFlap, true));

    // Solid Euro Hanger extension
    cuts.push(`M ${x4},${yMid} L ${x4 + 4},${yMid - W - headerH} L ${x5 - 4},${yMid - W - headerH} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    
    // Euro Slot Hanging Punch Out (Drawn using precise circular arc matching 'A' guidelines)
    const xc = (x4 + x5) / 2;
    const yc = yMid - W - headerH / 2;
    cuts.push(
      `M ${xc - 15},${yc - 2.5} ` +
      `A 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 ${xc - 10.5},${yc - 7} ` +
      `L ${xc - 4},${yc - 7} ` +
      `A 3.5 3.5 0 0 0 ${xc - 1.5},${yc - 3.5} ` +
      `L ${xc - 1},${yc - 3.5} ` +
      `A 1 1 0 0 1 ${xc + 1},${yc - 3.5} ` +

      `A 3.5 3.5 0 0 0 ${xc + 4},${yc - 7} ` +
      `L ${xc + 10.5},${yc - 7} ` +
      `A 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 ${xc + 15},${yc - 2.5} ` +
      `L ${xc + 15},${yc + 2.5} ` +
      `A 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 ${xc + 10.5},${yc + 7} ` +
      `L ${xc - 10.5},${yc + 7} ` +
      `A 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 ${xc - 15},${yc + 2.5} Z`
    );

    // Bottom Lid (Safe filleted tuck)
    cuts.push(`M ${x4},${yMid + H} L ${x4},${yMid + H + W}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H + W}`);
    cuts.push(drawTuckFlap(x4, x5, yMid + H + W, tuck, false));

    // Bottom Dust Flaps
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x1, x2, yMid + H, true, dustFlap, false));
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x3, x4, yMid + H, true, dustFlap, false));

    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    labels.push({ x: xc, y: yc + 2, text: `HOLE` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L: ${Math.round(L)}` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0215: CRASH-LOCK AUTO-BOTTOM (ته‌قفلی خودکار) ---
  'fefco-0215': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + L;
    const x3 = x2 + W;
    const x4 = x3 + L;
    const x5 = x4 + W;

    const yMid = 160;
    
    // Proportional flap height based on W (nominally W / 2 + offset). 
    // We cap it to prevent overlaps or collisions with small box modes.
    const hB = snap(Math.max(25, Math.min(L * 0.45, W * 0.5 + 4)));

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yMid - (W + tuck + 15);
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yMid + H + hB + 20;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Horizontal creases
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    
    // Vertical creases separating panels
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));
    
    // Top Lid crease
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid - W} L ${x3},${yMid - W}`);

    // --- 45-Degree Crease (Score) Lines for Crash Hook Bottom ---
    // Specifically on Flap 1 (under L1, x1-x2) and Flap 3 (under L2, x3-x4)
    // In professional auto-bottoms, these creases start at the bottom-left corner of L1 and L2 (x1 and x3)
    // going down and right at 45 degrees, i.e., M x1, yB L x1+hB, yB+hB
    const yB = yMid + H;
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yB} L ${x1 + hB},${yB + hB}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${yB} L ${x3 + hB},${yB + hB}`);

    // Glue joint (Tapered) on left edge of the tube
    const gtTapTop = 5;
    const gtTapBot = 8;
    const rT = 3;
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x1},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop} ` +
      `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop + rT} ` +
      `L ${x0 + 2},${yMid + H - gtTapBot - rT} ` +
      `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + H - gtTapBot} ` +
      `L ${x1},${yMid + H}`
    );

    const drawTuckFlap = (startX: number, endX: number, foldY: number, tH: number, isTop: boolean) => {
      const taperX = 5;
      const sign = isTop ? -1 : 1;
      const yTip = foldY + sign * tH;
      return `M ${startX},${foldY} ` +
             `L ${startX + taperX},${yTip} ` +
             `L ${endX - taperX},${yTip} ` +
             `L ${endX},${foldY}`;
    };

    // Top Tuck Lid
    cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yMid - W}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid - W}`);
    cuts.push(drawTuckFlap(x2, x3, yMid - W, tuck, true));

    const drawDustFlap = (staX: number, endX: number, foldY: number, hasTaper: boolean, dH: number, isTop: boolean) => {
      const taperX = dH * 0.268; // 15 degrees
      const gap = 1.5;
      const sign = isTop ? -1 : 1;
      const dy = foldY + sign * dH;
      return `M ${staX},${foldY} ` +
             `L ${staX + gap},${foldY + sign * gap} ` +
             `L ${staX + gap + taperX},${dy} ` +
             `L ${endX - gap - taperX},${dy} ` +
             `L ${endX - gap},${foldY + sign * gap} ` +
              `L ${endX},${foldY}`;
    };

    // Dust flaps top (under W1 and W2 panels at yMid)
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x1, x2, yMid, true, dustFlap, true));
    cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x3, x4, yMid, true, dustFlap, true));

    // --- Bottom Interlocking Crash-Lock Flaps ---
    // Beautiful, professional geometries following international standards

    // Flap 1 (under L1, from x1 to x2) - include a glue wing to the left for standard folder-gluers
    const leftWingX = x0 + 4;
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x1},${yB} ` +
      `L ${leftWingX},${yB + 4} ` +
      `L ${leftWingX},${yB + hB * 0.45} ` +
      `L ${x1 + hB * 0.2},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x1 + L * 0.6},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x1 + L - 5},${yB + hB * 0.3} ` +
      `L ${x2},${yB}`
    );

    // Flap 2 (under W1, from x2 to x3) - 45-degree slant on left side, slight taper on right, to accept Flap 3's glued triangle
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x2},${yB} ` +
      `L ${x2 + hB},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x3 - 8},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x3},${yB}`
    );

    // Flap 3 (under L2, from x3 to x4) - symmetric to Flap 1 but without left glue wing extension
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x3},${yB} ` +
      `L ${x3 + 8},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x3 + L * 0.6},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x3 + L - 5},${yB + hB * 0.3} ` +
      `L ${x4},${yB}`
    );

    // Flap 4 (under W2, from x4 to x5) - identical to Flap 2 (slants at 45 on left, slight taper on right)
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x4},${yB} ` +
      `L ${x4 + hB},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x5 - 8},${yB + hB} ` +
      `L ${x5},${yB}`
    );

    // Side outer cut for the Panel 4 right side (joins the glue tab)
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L: ${Math.round(L)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W: ${Math.round(W)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x3+x4)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L: ${Math.round(L)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x4+x5)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W: ${Math.round(W)}` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0300: TELESCOPIC 2-piece LID & TRAY (تلسکوپی دو تکه) ---
  'fefco-0300': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const gap = 100;
    
    // --- PART A: BASE (TRAY) ---
    const x_b1 = x0;
    const x_b2 = x_b1 + H;
    const x_b3 = x_b2 + L;
    const x_b4 = x_b3 + H;

    const y_b1 = 150;
    const y_b2 = y_b1 + H;
    const y_b3 = y_b2 + W;
    const y_b4 = y_b3 + H;

    // --- PART B: LID (COVER) ---
    const boxPlayOffset = 2.5; 
    const L_l = L + boxPlayOffset;
    const W_l = W + boxPlayOffset;
    const H_l = Math.max(20, H * 0.55); 

    const x_l1 = x_b4 + gap;
    const x_l2 = x_l1 + H_l;
    const x_l3 = x_l2 + L_l;
    const x_l4 = x_l3 + H_l;

    const y_l1 = y_b2 + (W - W_l) / 2;
    const y_l2 = y_l1 + H_l;
    const y_l3 = y_l2 + W_l;
    const y_l4 = y_l3 + H_l;

    const xMin = x_b1;
    const yMin = Math.min(y_b1, y_l1) - 20;
    const xMax = x_l4 + 10;
    const yMax = Math.max(y_b4, y_l4) + 20;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // --- BASE TRAY CREASES ---
    creases.push(`M ${x_b2},${y_b2} L ${x_b3},${y_b2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_b2},${y_b3} L ${x_b3},${y_b3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_b2},${y_b2} L ${x_b2},${y_b3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_b3},${y_b2} L ${x_b3},${y_b3}`);

    // Vertical creases for the glue tab folds
    creases.push(`M ${x_b2},${y_b1} L ${x_b2},${y_b2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_b3},${y_b1} L ${x_b3},${y_b2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_b2},${y_b3} L ${x_b2},${y_b4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_b3},${y_b3} L ${x_b3},${y_b4}`);

    // Base Tray Outer Cuts (Perfect continuous outline loop with 15° tapers)
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x_b1},${y_b1 + 3} ` +
      `L ${x_b2},${y_b1} ` + 
      `L ${x_b3},${y_b1} ` + 
      `L ${x_b4},${y_b1 + 3} ` + 
      `L ${x_b4},${y_b2} ` + 
      `L ${x_b4},${y_b3} ` + 
      `L ${x_b4},${y_b4 - 3} ` + 
      `L ${x_b3},${y_b4} ` + 
      `L ${x_b2},${y_b4} ` + 
      `L ${x_b1},${y_b4 - 3} ` + 
      `L ${x_b1},${y_b3} ` + 
      `L ${x_b1},${y_b2} ` + 
      `Z`
    );

    // Flat Horizontal slit cuts for corner folding tabs
    cuts.push(`M ${x_b1},${y_b2} L ${x_b2},${y_b2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x_b3},${y_b2} L ${x_b4},${y_b2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x_b1},${y_b3} L ${x_b2},${y_b3}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x_b3},${y_b3} L ${x_b4},${y_b3}`);

    // --- LID CREASES ---
    creases.push(`M ${x_l2},${y_l2} L ${x_l3},${y_l2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_l2},${y_l3} L ${x_l3},${y_l3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_l2},${y_l2} L ${x_l2},${y_l3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_l3},${y_l2} L ${x_l3},${y_l3}`);

    // Vertical creases for the Lid glue tab folds
    creases.push(`M ${x_l2},${y_l1} L ${x_l2},${y_l2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_l3},${y_l1} L ${x_l3},${y_l2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_l2},${y_l3} L ${x_l2},${y_l4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x_l3},${y_l3} L ${x_l3},${y_l4}`);

    // Lid Outer Cuts loop with 15° tapers
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x_l1},${y_l1 + 3} ` +
      `L ${x_l2},${y_l1} ` + 
      `L ${x_l3},${y_l1} ` + 
      `L ${x_l4},${y_l1 + 3} ` + 
      `L ${x_l4},${y_l2} ` + 
      `L ${x_l4},${y_l3} ` + 
      `L ${x_l4},${y_l4 - 3} ` + 
      `L ${x_l3},${y_l4} ` + 
      `L ${x_l2},${y_l4} ` + 
      `L ${x_l1},${y_l4 - 3} ` + 
      `L ${x_l1},${y_l3} ` + 
      `L ${x_l1},${y_l2} ` + 
      `Z`
    );

    // Lid horizontal slit cuts
    cuts.push(`M ${x_l1},${y_l2} L ${x_l2},${y_l2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x_l3},${y_l2} L ${x_l4},${y_l2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x_l1},${y_l3} L ${x_l2},${y_l3}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x_l3},${y_l3} L ${x_l4},${y_l3}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x_b2+x_b3)/2, y: (y_b2+y_b3)/2 + 10, text: `TRAY (زیره)` });
    labels.push({ x: (x_l2+x_l3)/2, y: (y_l2+y_l3)/2 + 10, text: `LID (رویه)` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0320: OUTSIDE RETRACT FOLD TRAY (کیبوردی ته‌بسته دو دیواره) ---
  'fefco-0320': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0;
    const x2 = x1 + H * 2;
    const x3 = x2 + L;
    const x4 = x3 + H * 2;

    const y1 = 150;
    const y2 = y1 + H * 2;
    const y3 = y2 + W;
    const y4 = y3 + H * 2;

    const xMin = x1;
    const yMin = y1 - 15;
    const xMax = x4 + 10;
    const yMax = y4 + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Double-wall creases
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y2} L ${x3},${y2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y2 - H} L ${x3},${y2 - H}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y3} L ${x3},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y3 + H} L ${x3},${y3 + H}`);

    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y2} L ${x2},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2 - H},${y2} L ${x2 - H},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${y2} L ${x3},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3 + H},${y2} L ${x3 + H},${y3}`);

    // Cuts (100% polygonal matching ArtiosCAD system)
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x2},${y1} L ${x3},${y1} ` + 
      `L ${x3},${y2} L ${x4},${y2} L ${x4},${y3} L ${x3},${y3} ` +
      `L ${x3},${y4} L ${x2},${y4} L ${x2},${y3} L ${x1},${y3} L ${x1},${y2} L ${x2},${y2} Z`
    );

    // Locking miter cuts
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${y2} L ${x2 - H},${y2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + H},${y2} L ${x4},${y2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${y3} L ${x2 - H},${y3}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + H},${y3} L ${x4},${y4 - H*2}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: y2 + W/2, text: `FLAT RETRACT` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- ECMA B10: TUBULAR PACKAGING SLEEVE (غلاف آستینی کشویی) ---
  'ecma-b10': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + W;
    const x3 = x2 + L;
    const x4 = x3 + W;
    const x5 = x4 + L;

    const yMid = 160;

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yMid - 15;
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yMid + H + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Creases
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));

    // Glue Tab
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x0 + 4},${yMid + 8} L ${x0 + 4},${yMid + H - 8} L ${x1},${yMid + H}`);
    
    // Sleeve Outer Contour
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H} L ${x1},${yMid + H} Z`);

    // Semicircular thumbpull index notch (A command used for precise circular slot cutting!)
    const notchR = 12;
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H/2 - notchR} A ${notchR} ${notchR} 0 0 1 ${x1},${yMid + H/2 + notchR}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid + H/2 - notchR} A ${notchR} ${notchR} 0 0 0 ${x5},${yMid + H/2 + notchR}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `SLEEVE (غلاف)` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- ECMA C10.20: MATCHBOX STYLE DRAWER & SHELL (کبریتی کشویی) ---
  'ecma-c1020': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const gap = 80;
    
    // Outer sleeve
    const sx1 = x0;
    const sx2 = sx1 + W;
    const sx3 = sx2 + L;
    const sx4 = sx3 + W;
    const sx5 = sx4 + L;

    const yMid = 160;

    // Drawer Tray (Exact math layout of base block)
    const dx1 = sx5 + gap;
    const dx2 = dx1 + H;
    const dx3 = dx2 + L;
    const dx4 = dx3 + H;

    const dy1 = yMid - H;
    const dy2 = yMid;
    const dy3 = dy2 + W;
    const dy4 = dy3 + H;

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = Math.min(yMid - 10, dy1) - 15;
    const xMax = dx4 + 10;
    const yMax = Math.max(yMid + H + 10, dy4) + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Creases: Shell
    [sx1, sx2, sx3, sx4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));
    creases.push(`M ${sx1},${yMid} L ${sx5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${sx1},${yMid + H} L ${sx5},${yMid + H}`);

    // Creases: Drawer inner boundaries
    creases.push(`M ${dx2},${dy2} L ${dx3},${dy2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${dx2},${dy3} L ${dx3},${dy3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${dx2},${dy2} L ${dx2},${dy3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${dx3},${dy2} L ${dx3},${dy3}`);

    // Vertical creases for the drawer glue tabs to fold along
    creases.push(`M ${dx2},${dy1} L ${dx2},${dy2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${dx3},${dy1} L ${dx3},${dy2}`);
    creases.push(`M ${dx2},${dy3} L ${dx2},${dy4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${dx3},${dy3} L ${dx3},${dy4}`);

    // Cuts: Sleeve profile
    cuts.push(`M ${sx1},${yMid} L ${sx5},${yMid} L ${sx5},${yMid + H} L ${sx1},${yMid + H} Z`);

    // Semicircular thumbpull index notch on the shell
    const notchR = 12;
    cuts.push(`M ${sx1},${yMid + H/2 - notchR} A ${notchR} ${notchR} 0 0 1 ${sx1},${yMid + H/2 + notchR}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${sx5},${yMid + H/2 - notchR} A ${notchR} ${notchR} 0 0 0 ${sx5},${yMid + H/2 + notchR}`);

    // Cuts: Drawer Outer Outline Contour (with perfect 15° tapers to avoid friction/clashes)
    cuts.push(
      `M ${dx1},${dy1 + 3} ` +
      `L ${dx2},${dy1} ` + 
      `L ${dx3},${dy1} ` + 
      `L ${dx4},${dy1 + 3} ` + 
      `L ${dx4},${dy2} ` + 
      `L ${dx4},${dy3} ` + 
      `L ${dx4},${dy4 - 3} ` + 
      `L ${dx3},${dy4} ` + 
      `L ${dx2},${dy4} ` + 
      `L ${dx1},${dy4 - 3} ` + 
      `L ${dx1},${dy3} ` + 
      `L ${dx1},${dy2} ` + 
      `Z`
    );

    // Horizontal slit cuts that release corner flaps from end panels
    cuts.push(`M ${dx1},${dy2} L ${dx2},${dy2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${dx3},${dy2} L ${dx4},${dy2}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${dx1},${dy3} L ${dx2},${dy3}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${dx3},${dy3} L ${dx4},${dy3}`);

    // Thumb pull circular notch (A command)
    const dcx = dx2 + L / 2;
    const dcy = dy2;
    cuts.push(`M ${dcx - 12},${dcy} A 12 12 0 0 0 ${dcx + 12},${dcy}`);

    labels.push({ x: (sx2+sx3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `SHELL` });
    labels.push({ x: dcx, y: dy2 + W/2, text: `DRAWER` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- ECMA D50: COUNTERTOP EXHIBIT MERCHANDISE STAND (استند رومیزی دیسپلی) ---
  'ecma-d50': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0;
    const x2 = x1 + W;
    const x3 = x2 + L;
    const x4 = x3 + W;

    const yMid = 180;
    const headerPlateH = H * 1.1; 
    const frontLipH = Math.max(25, H * 0.28); 

    const xMin = x1;
    const yMin = yMid - headerPlateH - 25;
    const xMax = x4 + 10;
    const yMax = yMid + W + frontLipH + 20;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Folds
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid + W} L ${x3},${yMid + W}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yMid + W}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid + W}`);

    // Cuts: Pristine angled display silhouette matching laser specifications
    cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yMid - headerPlateH} L ${x3},${yMid - headerPlateH} L ${x3},${yMid}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x1},${yMid + W - frontLipH} L ${x1},${yMid + W} L ${x2},${yMid + W}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x4},${yMid + W - frontLipH} L ${x4},${yMid + W} L ${x3},${yMid + W}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid + W} L ${x2},${yMid + W + frontLipH} L ${x3},${yMid + W + frontLipH} L ${x3},${yMid + W}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid - headerPlateH / 2, text: `HEADER` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + W/2, text: `STAND BASE` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0426: PIZZA BOX CLASSIC (جعبه پیتزا کلاسیک) ---
  'fefco-pizza': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    // FEFCO 0426 / 0427 Pizza Box CAD Engine
    const x2 = x0 + 35;
    const x3 = x2 + L;

    const yMid = 180;
    const y1 = yMid - H; 
    const y2 = y1 - W;   
    const yTuck = y2 - Math.max(15, H * 0.9);

    const y3 = yMid + W; 
    const y4 = y3 + H;   
    const y5 = y4 + H;   

    const xMin = x2 - H * 2.2 - 20;
    const yMin = yTuck - 20;
    const xMax = x3 + H * 2.2 + 20;
    const yMax = y5 + 20;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // --- MAIN FOLD CREASES (REDS / DOTS) ---
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y1} L ${x3},${y1}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y3} L ${x3},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y4} L ${x3},${y4}`);

    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y1} L ${x2},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${y1} L ${x3},${y3}`);

    // Roll-over double wall side creases for bottom tray
    creases.push(`M ${x2 - H},${yMid} L ${x2 - H},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2 - 2*H},${yMid} L ${x2 - 2*H},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3 + H},${yMid} L ${x3 + H},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3 + 2*H},${yMid} L ${x3 + 2*H},${y3}`);

    // Lid side crease folds
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y2} L ${x2},${y1}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${y2} L ${x3},${y1}`);

    // --- CAD FLAT BOUNDARY CUT LINES (BLACKS / OUTLINE) ---
    // Lid front tuck flap and lid outline
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x2},${y2} ` +
      `L ${x2 + 10},${yTuck} ` +
      `L ${x3 - 10},${yTuck} ` +
      `L ${x3},${y2} ` +
      // Lid right side flap
      `L ${x3 + H},${y2} ` +
      `L ${x3 + H},${y1} ` +
      // Back wall right transition
      `L ${x3},${y1} ` +
      // Bottom tray right double roll-over walls (with locking tabs!)
      `L ${x3 + 2*H},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x3 + 2*H},${y3} ` +
      `L ${x3 + H},${y3} ` +
      // Front wall folding flaps
      `L ${x3 + H - 4},${y4} ` +
      `L ${x3},${y4} ` +
      // Front inner fold-over flap
      `L ${x3 - 12},${y5} ` +
      `L ${x2 + 12},${y5} ` +
      `L ${x2},${y4} ` +
      // Front wall left folding flaps
      `L ${x2 - H + 4},${y4} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H},${y3} ` +
      // Bottom tray left double roll-over walls (locking tabs!)
      `L ${x2 - 2*H},${y3} ` +
      `L ${x2 - 2*H},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x2},${y1} ` +
      // Lid left side flap
      `L ${x2 - H},${y1} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H},${y2} ` +
      `Z`
    );

    // --- Pizza Ventilation Air Holes ---
    // 2 high-fidelity vent holes (diameter 12mm / radius 6mm) in back panel or lid
    const ventRadius = 6;
    const leftVentCx = x2 + L * 0.25;
    const rightVentCx = x3 - L * 0.25;
    const ventCy = yMid - H / 2;

    cuts.push(`M ${leftVentCx - ventRadius},${ventCy} A ${ventRadius} ${ventRadius} 0 1 0 ${leftVentCx + ventRadius},${ventCy} A ${ventRadius} ${ventRadius} 0 1 0 ${leftVentCx - ventRadius},${ventCy}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${rightVentCx - ventRadius},${ventCy} A ${ventRadius} ${ventRadius} 0 1 0 ${rightVentCx + ventRadius},${ventCy} A ${ventRadius} ${ventRadius} 0 1 0 ${rightVentCx - ventRadius},${ventCy}`);

    // Labels
    labels.push({ x: (x2 + x3) / 2, y: (y2 + y1) / 2, text: 'TOP LID (درب جعبه)' });
    labels.push({ x: (x2 + x3) / 2, y: yMid + W / 2, text: 'BOTTOM BASE (کف جعبه)' });
    labels.push({ x: leftVentCx, y: ventCy + 12, text: 'VENT (منفذ هوا)', color: '#6366f1' });
    labels.push({ x: rightVentCx, y: ventCy + 12, text: 'VENT (منفذ هوا)', color: '#6366f1' });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0427: MAILER BOX PRO / KIBORDI (کیبوردی پستی ممتاز) ---
  'fefco-0427': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    // 100% CAD Industrial Standards compliant Mailer box rebuild.
    // Removes all curved approximations, replaced with precise 15° wing tapers
    // and standard folder-gluer dust lock wing profiles.
    const x2 = x0 + glueTab + 30; 
    const x3 = x2 + L;
    
    const yMid = 180;
    const y1 = yMid - W; 
    const y2 = y1 - H;   
    const yTuck = y2 - Math.max(16, H * 0.42); 
    
    const y3 = yMid + H; 
    const y4 = y3 + W;   
    const y5 = y4 + H;   
    const y6 = y5 + Math.max(15, H * 0.82); 

    const xMin = x2 - H * 2.2 - 20;
    const yMin = yTuck - 20;
    const xMax = x3 + H * 2.2 + 20;
    const yMax = y6 + 20;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // --- MAIN FOLD CREASES ---
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y1} L ${x3},${y1}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y3} L ${x3},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y4} L ${x3},${y4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y5} L ${x3},${y5}`);

    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y1} L ${x2},${y3}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${y1} L ${x3},${y3}`);

    // Roll-over double wall side creases
    creases.push(`M ${x2 - H},${y3} L ${x2 - H},${y4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${y3} L ${x2},${y4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3 + H},${y3} L ${x3 + H},${y4}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${y3} L ${x3},${y4}`);

    // --- CAD FLAT BOUNDARY CUT LINES (BEAUTIFULLY FILLETED & CURVED) ---
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x2},${y2} ` +
      `Q ${x2 + 3},${yTuck} ${x2 + 10},${yTuck} ` + // Smooth 10mm transition to the tuck plate
      `L ${x3 - 10},${yTuck} ` +
      `Q ${x3 - 3},${yTuck} ${x3},${y2} ` +
      // Symmetrical curved lid wings (Standard smooth fillets instead of sharp corners)
      `L ${x3 + H - 4},${y2 + 4} ` + 
      `Q ${x3 + H - 1.5},${y2 + 1.5} ${x3 + H - 1.5},${y2 + 6} ` + 
      `L ${x3 + H - 1.5},${y1 - 10} ` + 
      `Q ${x3 + H - 1.5},${y1 - 4} ${x3 + H - 6},${y1 - 4} ` +
      `L ${x3},${y1} ` +
      // Dust lid lock ear back flap with smooth rounded profile
      `L ${x3 + W * 0.48},${y1 + 4} ` +
      `Q ${x3 + W * 0.55},${y1 + 4} ${x3 + W * 0.55},${y1 + 9} ` +
      `L ${x3 + W * 0.55},${y3 - 13} ` +
      `Q ${x3 + W * 0.55},${y3 - 8} ${x3 + W * 0.48},${y3 - 8} ` +
      `L ${x3},${y3} ` +
      // Bottom panel double wrap sidewalls (Beautifully curved locking ears)
      `L ${x3 + H},${y3} ` +
      `L ${x3 + H * 1.7},${y3 + 4} ` + 
      `Q ${x3 + H * 1.92},${y3 + 6} ${x3 + H * 1.92},${y3 + 11} ` + 
      `L ${x3 + H * 1.92},${y4 - 11} ` +
      `Q ${x3 + H * 1.92},${y4 - 6} ${x3 + H * 1.7},${y4 - 4} ` +
      `L ${x3 + H},${y4} ` +
      // Front wall folding wings
      `L ${x3 + H - 5},${y5} ` +
      `L ${x3},${y5} ` +
      // Front roll-over tab
      `L ${x3 - 10},${y6} ` +
      `L ${x2 + 10},${y6} ` +
      `L ${x2},${y5} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H + 5},${y5} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H},${y4} ` +
      // Left double wrap sidewall (Mirrored & curved)
      `L ${x2 - H * 1.7},${y4 - 4} ` +
      `Q ${x2 - H * 1.92},${y4 - 6} ${x2 - H * 1.92},${y4 - 11} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H * 1.92},${y3 + 11} ` +
      `Q ${x2 - H * 1.92},${y3 + 6} ${x2 - H * 1.7},${y3 + 4} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H},${y3} ` +
      `L ${x2},${y3} ` +
      // Left dust lock wing with smooth rounded profile
      `L ${x2 - W * 0.48},${y3 - 8} ` +
      `Q ${x2 - W * 0.55},${y3 - 8} ${x2 - W * 0.55},${y3 - 13} ` +
      `L ${x2 - W * 0.55},${y1 + 9} ` +
      `Q ${x2 - W * 0.55},${y1 + 4} ${x2 - W * 0.48},${y1 + 4} ` +
      `L ${x2},${y1} ` +
      // Left curved lid wings
      `L ${x2 - H + 6},${y1 - 4} ` +
      `Q ${x2 - H + 1.5},${y1 - 4} ${x2 - H + 1.5},${y1 - 10} ` +
      `L ${x2 - H + 1.5},${y2 + 6} ` +
      `Q ${x2 - H + 1.5},${y2 + 1.5} ${x2 - H + 4},${y2 + 4} Z`
    );

    // Insertion locks slit cut vectors on bottom scoreline
    const slitOff = 12;
    cuts.push(`M ${x2 - 1},${y3 + slitOff} M ${x2 - 1},${y3 + W/2 - 6} L ${x2 - 1},${y3 + W/2 + 6}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + 1},${y3 + slitOff} M ${x3 + 1},${y3 + W/2 - 6} L ${x3 + 1},${y3 + W/2 + 6}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `BASE (L: ${Math.round(L)})` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: y1 - W/2, text: `LID (L x W)` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0200: SLOTTED HALFTYP TELESCOPIC BOX (روباز نیمه تلسکوپی) ---
  'fefco-0200': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + L;
    const x3 = x2 + W;
    const x4 = x3 + L;
    const x5 = x4 + W;

    const yMid = 130;
    const flapH = W / 2;
    const yBot = yMid + H + flapH;

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yMid - 15;
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yBot + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));

    // Flat Top (Open Top box standard)
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    
    // Tapered Glue Tab
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x0 + 4},${yMid + 6} L ${x0 + 4},${yMid + H - 6} L ${x1},${yMid + H}`);
    
    // Bottom Slots (3.3mm industrial laser clearances with corner release bevels)
    const gap = 1.65;
    cuts.push(`M ${x1 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x1 + gap},${yBot} L ${x2 - gap},${yBot} L ${x2 - gap},${yMid + H}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x2 + gap},${yBot} L ${x3 - gap},${yBot} L ${x3 - gap},${yMid + H}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x3 + gap},${yBot} L ${x4 - gap},${yBot} L ${x4 - gap},${yMid + H}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x4 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x4 + gap},${yBot} L ${x5},${yBot} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `OPEN-TOP (L)` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W: ${Math.round(W)}` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0203: FULL OVERLAP SLOTTED CONTAINER (هم‌پوشانی کامل درب) ---
  'fefco-0203': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + L;
    const x3 = x2 + W;
    const x4 = x3 + L;
    const x5 = x4 + W;

    const yMid = 140;
    const flapH = W; 
    const yTop = yMid - flapH;
    const yBot = yMid + H + flapH;

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yTop - 15;
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yBot + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));

    // Glue Tab
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x0 + 4},${yMid + 6} L ${x0 + 4},${yMid + H - 6} L ${x1},${yMid + H}`);
    
    // Slotted overlap top flaps
    const gap = 1.7;
    cuts.push(`M ${x1 + gap},${yMid} L ${x1 + gap},${yTop} L ${x2 - gap},${yTop} L ${x2 - gap},${yMid}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2 + gap},${yMid} L ${x2 + gap},${yTop} L ${x3 - gap},${yTop} L ${x3 - gap},${yMid}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + gap},${yMid} L ${x3 + gap},${yTop} L ${x4 - gap},${yTop} L ${x4 - gap},${yMid}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x4 + gap},${yMid} L ${x4 + gap},${yTop} L ${x5},${yTop} L ${x5},${yMid}`);

    // Slotted overlap bottom flaps
    cuts.push(`M ${x1 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x1 + gap},${yBot} L ${x2 - gap},${yBot} L ${x2 - gap},${yMid + H}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x2 + gap},${yBot} L ${x3 - gap},${yBot} L ${x3 - gap},${yMid + H}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x3 + gap},${yBot} L ${x4 - gap},${yBot} L ${x4 - gap},${yMid + H}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x4 + gap},${yMid + H} L ${x4 + gap},${yBot} L ${x5},${yBot} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    
    cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L: ${Math.round(L)}` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `OVERLAP` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0201: RSC STANDARD AMERICAN CARTON (کارتن دایکاتی ساده RSC) ---
  'default-rsc': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
    const x2 = x1 + L;
    const x3 = x2 + W;
    const x4 = x3 + L;
    const x5 = x4 + W;

    const yMid = 140;
    const flapH = W / 2; 
    const yTop = yMid - flapH;
    const yBot = yMid + H + flapH;

    const xMin = x0;
    const yMin = yTop - 15;
    const xMax = x5 + 10;
    const yMax = yBot + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    // Folds
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);
    [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yMid + H}`));
    creases.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    // Professional rounded Glue Tab
    cuts.push(
      `M ${x1},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x0 + 8},${yMid + 4} ` +
      `A 4 4 0 0 0 ${x0 + 5},${yMid + 8} ` +
      `L ${x0 + 5},${yMid + H - 8} ` +
      `A 4 4 0 0 0 ${x0 + 8},${yMid + H - 4} ` +
      `L ${x1},${yMid + H}`
    );
    
    // Smooth U-shape standard CAD slots
    const gap = 2.5; // Standard 5mm total slot width
    
    const drawTopSlot = (cx: number) => {
      cuts.push(
        `M ${cx - gap},${yTop} ` +
        `L ${cx - gap},${yMid - gap} ` +
        `A ${gap} ${gap} 0 0 0 ${cx + gap},${yMid - gap} ` +
        `L ${cx + gap},${yTop}`
      );
    };

    const drawBotSlot = (cx: number) => {
      cuts.push(
        `M ${cx - gap},${yBot} ` +
        `L ${cx - gap},${yMid + H + gap} ` +
        `A ${gap} ${gap} 0 0 1 ${cx + gap},${yMid + H + gap} ` +
        `L ${cx + gap},${yBot}`
      );
    };

    // Draw the slot cuts
    [x2, x3, x4].forEach(drawTopSlot);
    [x2, x3, x4].forEach(drawBotSlot);

    // Draw flap outer perimeters (top)
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x1},${yTop} L ${x2 - gap},${yTop}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2 + gap},${yTop} L ${x3 - gap},${yTop}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + gap},${yTop} L ${x4 - gap},${yTop}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x4 + gap},${yTop} L ${x5},${yTop} L ${x5},${yMid}`);

    // Draw flap outer perimeters (bottom)
    cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + H} L ${x1},${yBot} L ${x2 - gap},${yBot}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x2 + gap},${yBot} L ${x3 - gap},${yBot}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x3 + gap},${yBot} L ${x4 - gap},${yBot}`);
    cuts.push(`M ${x4 + gap},${yBot} L ${x5},${yBot} L ${x5},${yMid + H}`);

    labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `RSC (L: ${Math.round(L)})` });
    labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `RSC (W: ${Math.round(W)})` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  },

  // --- FEFCO 0409: INTERLOCKING WRAPAROUND SLEEVE (کاور لفافه‌ای دایکاتی) ---
  'fefco-0409': ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
    const x1 = x0 + H;
    const x2 = x1 + W;
    const x3 = x2 + H;
    const x4 = x3 + W;

    const yMid = 140;
    const yTop = yMid - H;
    const yBot = yMid + L + H;

    const xMin = x0 - 15;
    const yMin = yTop - 15;
    const xMax = x4 + 15;
    const yMax = yBot + 15;

    const creases: string[] = [];
    const cuts: string[] = [];
    const labels: any[] = [];

    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x1},${yMid + L}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yMid + L}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid + L}`);
    
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid}`);
    creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid + L} L ${x3},${yMid + L}`);

    cuts.push(
      `M ${x0},${yMid} L ${x1},${yMid} L ${x1},${yTop} L ${x2},${yTop} L ${x2},${yMid} ` +
      `L ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yTop} L ${x4},${yMid} L ${x4},${yMid + L} L ${x3},${yMid + L} ` +
      `L ${x3},${yBot} L ${x2},${yBot} L ${x2},${yMid + L} L ${x1},${yMid + L} ` +
      `L ${x0},${yMid + L} Z`
    );

    labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + L/2, text: `WRAP (L x W)` });

    return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
  }
};

STANDARD_DIELINE_ENGINES['fefco-0201'] = STANDARD_DIELINE_ENGINES['default-rsc'];
STANDARD_DIELINE_ENGINES['fefco-0470'] = ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {
  const x1 = x0 + H;
  const x2 = x1 + L;
  const x3 = x2 + H;

  const yMid = 160;
  const yTop = yMid - W;

  creases.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yMid + W}`);

  cuts.push(
    `M ${x1},${yTop} ` +
    `L ${x1 + 6},${yTop - tuck} L ${x2 - 6},${yTop - tuck} L ${x2},${yTop} ` +
    `L ${x2},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid} L ${x3},${yMid + W} L ${x2},${yMid + W} ` +
    `L ${x2},${yBot} L ${x1},${yBot} L ${x1},${yMid + W} ` +
    `L ${x0},${yMid + W} L ${x0},${yMid} L ${x1},${yMid} Z`
  );

  labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + W/2, text: `L x W` });

  return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
};

STANDARD_DIELINE_ENGINES['fefco-0713'] = ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0 }) => {

           `L ${xEnd - gap - 6},${yMid - height} ` +
           `A 3 3 0 0 1 ${xEnd - gap - 3},${yMid - height + 3} ` +

           `A 3 3 0 0 1 ${xEnd - gap},${yMid}`;
  };

  cuts.push(drawTopFlap(x2, x3, W/2));
  cuts.push(drawTopFlap(x3, x4, W/2));
  cuts.push(drawTopFlap(x4, x5, W/2));

    `A 3 3 0 0 0 ${x2 - 12},${yB + hB - 3} ` +

    `M ${x2},${yB} ` +

    `A 3 3 0 0 0 ${x3 + 9},${yB + hB} ` +

STANDARD_DIELINE_ENGINES['snap-lock-123'] = ({ L, W, H, glueTab, tuck, dustFlap, x0, variant = 'standard' }) => {
  const x1 = x0 + glueTab;
  const x2 = x1 + L;
  const x3 = x2 + W;
  const x4 = x3 + L;
  const x5 = x4 + W;

  const yMid = 180;
  const yTop = yMid - W; 
  const yB = yMid + H;
  
  const hBottomL = W / 2 + 15; // Flap 1 and 3 height
  const hBottomW = W / 2 + 5;  // Flap 2 and 4 height
  const yBot = yB + hBottomL;

  const xMin = x0;
  const yMin = yTop - (tuck + 15);
  const xMax = x5;
  const yMax = yB + Math.max(hBottomL, hBottomW);

  const creases: string[] = [];
  const cuts: string[] = [];
  const labels: any[] = [];

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // CREASES (Fold Lines)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  
  // Horizontal bounds (Top and Bottom of main panels)
  creases.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x5},${yMid}`);
  creases.push(`M ${x1},${yB} L ${x5},${yB}`);

  // Vertical bounds separating panels
  [x1, x2, x3, x4].forEach(x => {
    creases.push(`M ${x},${yMid} L ${x},${yB}`);
  });
  
  // Top Lid inner fold
  creases.push(`M ${x1},${yTop} L ${x2},${yTop}`);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // CUTS (Die Lines)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  
  // -- GLUE TAB (Panel 1 Left) --
  const gtTapTop = 5;
  const gtTapBot = 8;
  const rT = 3; // radius
  
  cuts.push(
    `M ${x1},${yMid} ` +
    `L ${x0 + rT + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop} ` +
    `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + 2},${yMid + gtTapTop + rT} ` +
    `L ${x0 + 2},${yB - gtTapBot - rT} ` +
    `A ${rT} ${rT} 0 0 0 ${x0 + rT + 2},${yB - gtTapBot} ` +
    `L ${x1},${yB}`
  );

  // -- TOP CLOSURE (Tuck & Dust Flaps) --

  // Panel 1: Top Lid & Friction Tuck
  // Vertical lid sides
  cuts.push(`M ${x1},${yMid} L ${x1},${yTop}`);
  cuts.push(`M ${x2},${yMid} L ${x2},${yTop}`);

  // Friction Tuck
  const tH = tuck;
  const fEar = 1.0; // small friction bump
  const fDrop = 6;
  const rCor = 4;
  cuts.push(
    `M ${x1},${yTop} ` +
    `Q ${x1 - fEar},${yTop - fDrop / 2} ${x1 - fEar},${yTop - fDrop} ` +
    `L ${x1 + 1.5},${yTop - tH + rCor} ` +
    `A ${rCor} ${rCor} 0 0 1 ${x1 + 1.5 + rCor},${yTop - tH} ` +
    `L ${x2 - 1.5 - rCor},${yTop - tH} ` +
    `A ${rCor} ${rCor} 0 0 1 ${x2 - 1.5},${yTop - tH + rCor} ` +
    `L ${x2 + fEar},${yTop - fDrop} ` +
    `Q ${x2 + fEar},${yTop - fDrop / 2} ${x2},${yTop}`
  );

  // Panel 2 & 4: Top Dust Flaps
  const rDust = 8;
  const drawDustFlap = (staX: number, endX: number) => {
    const gap = 1;
    const dy = yMid - dustFlap;
    return `M ${staX},${yMid} ` +
           `L ${staX + gap},${yMid} ` +
           `L ${staX + gap},${yMid - 5} ` +
           `Q ${staX + gap},${dy} ${staX + gap + rDust},${dy} ` +
           `L ${endX - gap - rDust},${dy} ` +
           `Q ${endX - gap},${dy} ${endX - gap},${yMid - 5} ` +
           `L ${endX - gap},${yMid} ` +
           `L ${endX},${yMid}`;
  };
  cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x2, x3));
  cuts.push(drawDustFlap(x4, x5));

  // Panel 3: Flat Top Edge
  cuts.push(`M ${x3},${yMid} L ${x4},${yMid}`);

  // Right vertical drop (Panel 4 right edge)
  cuts.push(`M ${x5},${yMid} L ${x5},${yB}`);

  // -- BOTTOM SNAP LOCK (1-2-3 BOTTOM) --
  // This is the core 1-2-3 CAD standard with beautiful, tear-preventing fillets

  // Panel 1: Locking Tongue Flap (folds last, has large filleted catch tab)
  const lockH = hBottomL;
  const tabW = variant === 'reinforced' ? L * 0.48 : L * 0.4;
  
  // Ear and neck parameters for the locking mechanism
  const earWidth = Math.min(6, L * 0.05); // width of the lock ears
  const neckW = tabW - earWidth * 2;       // narrower neck width
  const rFillet = 4;
  
  const shoulderY = yB + lockH * 0.5;      // height of shoulders
  const slantX = Math.min(25, L * 0.2);     // shoulder slant
  
  const tabLeft = x1 + L / 2 - tabW / 2;
  const tabRight = x1 + L / 2 + tabW / 2;
  const neckLeft = x1 + L / 2 - neckW / 2;
  const neckRight = x1 + L / 2 + neckW / 2;

  cuts.push(
    `M ${x1},${yB} ` +
    `L ${x1 + slantX},${shoulderY} ` +
    `L ${neckLeft},${shoulderY} ` +
    `L ${neckLeft},${yB + lockH - 12} ` +
    `L ${tabLeft},${yB + lockH - 12} ` +
    `L ${tabLeft},${yB + lockH - rFillet} ` +
    `Q ${tabLeft},${yB + lockH} ${tabLeft + rFillet},${yB + lockH} ` +
    `L ${tabRight - rFillet},${yB + lockH} ` +
    `Q ${tabRight},${yB + lockH} ${tabRight},${yB + lockH - rFillet} ` +
    `L ${tabRight},${yB + lockH - 12} ` +
    `L ${neckRight},${yB + lockH - 12} ` +
    `L ${neckRight},${shoulderY} ` +
    `L ${x2 - slantX},${shoulderY} ` +
    `L ${x2},${yB}`
  );

  // Panel 2: Left Side Flap / Wing
  const wHg = hBottomW;
  const wingSlant = wHg; // 45-degree slant to avoid collision with fold
  const wingTaper = Math.min(10, W * 0.12); // clean taper on outside edge

  cuts.push(
    `M ${x2},${yB} ` +
    `L ${x2 + wingTaper},${yB + wHg} ` +
    `L ${x3 - wingSlant},${yB + wHg} ` +
    `L ${x3},${yB}`
  );

  // Panel 3: U-shaped receiver flap
  const uH = hBottomL;
  const slotW = tabW - earWidth; // slightly narrower than the tab, wider than the neck
  const slotL = x3 + L / 2 - slotW / 2;
  const slotR = x3 + L / 2 + slotW / 2;

  cuts.push(
    `M ${x3},${yB} ` +
    `L ${x3 + wingTaper},${yB + uH} ` +
    `L ${slotL - 6},${yB + uH} ` +
    `L ${slotL},${yB + uH - 6} ` +
    `L ${slotL},${yB + uH - 12} ` +
    `L ${slotR},${yB + uH - 12} ` +
    `L ${slotR},${yB + uH - 6} ` +
    `L ${slotR + 6},${yB + uH} ` +
    `L ${x4 - wingTaper},${yB + uH} ` +
    `L ${x4},${yB}`
  );

  // Panel 4: Right Side Flap / Wing (Mirrored to Panel 2)
  cuts.push(
    `M ${x4},${yB} ` +
    `L ${x4 + wingSlant},${yB + wHg} ` +
    `L ${x5 - wingTaper},${yB + wHg} ` +
    `L ${x5},${yB}`
  );

  // Labels
  labels.push({ x: (x1+x2)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L` });
  labels.push({ x: (x2+x3)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W` });
  labels.push({ x: (x3+x4)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `L` });
  labels.push({ x: (x4+x5)/2, y: yMid + H/2, text: `W` });

  return { cuts, creases, labels, totalW: xMax - xMin, totalH: yMax - yMin, xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax };
};

import { GoogleGenAI, GenerateContentResponse } from "@google/genai";

// Initialize the client securely
const apiKey = process.env.API_KEY || ''; 

let aiClient: GoogleGenAI | null = null;

if (apiKey) {
  aiClient = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey });
}

// --- RAG Simulation: Technical Knowledge Base ---
const KNOWLEDGE_BASE = `
TECHNICAL SPECS FOR 'ASHK GHALAM':
1. Paper Types:
   - Glossy (Art Paper): Best for vivid colors, flyers, catalogs. Weight: 135-300gsm.
   - Inderboard (FBB): White back, stiff, FDA approved for food/pharma. Good for boxes.
   - Kraft: Brown/Recycled look, high tear resistance, eco-friendly.
   - Linen: Textured surface, premium feel for business cards.

2. Finishes:
   - UV Spot: High gloss coating on specific areas. Requires a mask file (K100).
   - Matte Lamination: Smooth, non-reflective, elegant.
   - Gold Foil (Hot Stamping): Metallic effect, requires a separate die.

3. File Requirements (Pre-flight):
   - Color Mode: CMYK (RGB will be converted and may shift).
   - Resolution: 300 DPI minimum.
   - Bleed: 3mm on all sides.
   - Safe Zone: 5mm from edge.
   - Formats: PDF (X-1a preferred), AI, TIFF.

4. Machines:
   - Speedmaster XL 75: For large runs (Offset).
   - Indigo 7900: For short runs (Digital).
`;

export const generateAIPattern = async (prompt: string): Promise<string> => {
  if (!aiClient) return "";
  try {
    const response = await aiClient.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image',
      contents: {
        parts: [
          {
            text: `A seamless repeating pattern of ${prompt}, flat design, vector style, suitable for packaging background.`,
          },
        ],
      },
      config: {
        imageConfig: {
          aspectRatio: "1:1",
        },
      },
    });
    
    for (const part of response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || []) {
      if (part.inlineData) {
        return `data:image/png;base64,${part.inlineData.data}`;
      }
    }
    return "";
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error generating pattern:", error);
    return "";
  }
};
export const generateSupportResponse = async (
  userMessage: string, 
  context: string = "general"
): Promise<string> => {
  if (!aiClient) return "سرویس هوش مصنوعی در دسترس نیست. لطفا کلید API را بررسی کنید.";

  try {
    const systemPrompt = `
      You are 'Ashk Ghalam AI', a highly technical support assistant for a printing industry platform.
      You speak fluent Persian (Farsi).
      
      USE THE FOLLOWING KNOWLEDGE BASE TO ANSWER ACCURATELY (Do not hallucinate specs):
      ${KNOWLEDGE_BASE}
      
      User Context: ${context}
      
      If the user asks about price, say "Price depends on daily paper rates."
      Keep answers professional, concise, and helpful.
    `;

    const response: GenerateContentResponse = await aiClient.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-3-flash-preview',
      contents: [
        { role: 'user', parts: [{ text: systemPrompt + "\n\nUser Question: " + userMessage }] }
      ],
      config: {
        thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 }
      }
    });

    return response.text || "متاسفم، در حال حاضر نمی‌توانم پاسخ دهم.";
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Gemini API Error:", error);
    if (error.message && (error.message.includes('fetch') || error.message.includes('network'))) {
      return "این بخش نیازمند دسترسی به هوش مصنوعی است. به دلیل محدودیت‌های اینترنت بین‌الملل، هم‌اکنون این امکان در دسترس نیست.";
    }
    return "خطا در برقراری ارتباط با هوش مصنوعی. این امکان نیازمند اینترنت آزاد (بدون فیلتر) می‌باشد.";
  }
};

export interface ExtractedOrder {
  category: 'business-card' | 'box' | 'flyer' | 'label' | 'other';
  quantity: number;
  paperType?: 'glossy-300' | 'matte-300' | 'linen' | 'kraft' | 'cardboard-ip';
  description: string;
}

export const extractOrderDetails = async (
  text: string
): Promise<ExtractedOrder | null> => {
  if (!aiClient) return null;

  try {
    const prompt = `
      Analyze this Persian print order request: "${text}".
      Map to:
      - category: 'business-card', 'box', 'flyer', 'label' or 'other'.
      - quantity: Number (default 1000).
      - paperType: 'glossy-300', 'matte-300', 'linen', 'kraft', 'cardboard-ip'.
      
      Return JSON only: { "category": "", "quantity": 0, "paperType": "", "description": "" }
    `;

    const response = await aiClient.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-3-flash-preview',
      contents: prompt,
      config: {
        responseMimeType: "application/json"
      }
    });

    const jsonText = response.text?.trim();
    if (jsonText) {
      return JSON.parse(jsonText) as ExtractedOrder;
    }
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error extracting order details:", error);
    return null;
  }
};

    const response = await aiClient.models.generateContent({
      model: 'gemini-3-flash-preview',
      contents: prompt,
      config: {
        responseMimeType: "application/json"
      }
    });

    const jsonText = response.text?.trim();
    if (jsonText) return JSON.parse(jsonText);
    throw new Error("Invalid response");
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Blog Gen Error", error);
    throw error;
  }
};
